items.description: CentralReach is a leading provider of autism and IDD care software for Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA), multidisciplinary therapy, and special education. Trusted by more than 200,000 users, we enable therapy providers, educators, and employers to scale the way they deliver ABA and related therapies with innovative technology, market-leading industry expertise, and world-class customer satisfaction. As a Technical Product Analyst at CentralReach, you will sit within the Data Product teams, supporting Product Managers by providing the analytical and technical depth needed to translate requirements into validated, production-ready data products. You will bridge the gap between product strategy and engineering execution, ensuring that the data logic underlying our analytics offerings is as sound as the features built on top of it. You will work closely with SQL-based data validation, requirements refinement, and process improvement, while also serving as a front-line resource for internal and external stakeholders with questions or issues related to data and dashboards. This is a hybrid role, part product execution, part data QA/validation, part process improvement, suited to someone who is comfortable owning ambiguity in data logic and wants to grow their product and analytical skill set within a fast-moving healthcare data organization. Responsibilities: Partner with the ABI and DW Product Managers to refine requirements, define acceptance criteria, and support backlog grooming and release readiness. Own SQL-based data validation and metric reconciliation, verifying source-to-target data logic and data transformation into the elasticubes. Direct and interpret output from AI-agent QA tooling, designing test cases and following up on discrepancies. Investigate reported data discrepancies and production issues, distinguishing upstream pipeline problems from BI-layer or presentation issues, and escalate to Engineering when appropriate. Serve as the front-line owner for internal and external user questions on data and dashboards, triaging and resolving requests or routing them to the right team. Support regression testing across releases, ensuring prior fixes and validated logic remain intact as new features and data sources are introduced. Turn recurring manual checks into reusable, documented validation rules, and identify opportunities to automate QA and data-quality workflows. Conduct market, competitive, and data-driven research on an ad hoc basis to support PM decision-making. Maintain clear documentation of requirements, test cases, validation results, and known issues to build a durable artifact trail for both product teams. Communicate validation findings, risk areas, and open issues clearly to PMs, Engineering, and other stakeholders, including status updates during release cycles. Desired Skills & Experience 2+ years of experience in a data analyst, BI analyst, QA/data validation, or technical product analyst role, ideally in a healthcare or SaaS data environment. Strong proficiency in writing and reading SQL, with the ability to validate data against source-to-target logic rather than relying solely on BI-layer output. Hands-on experience with BI reporting and visualization tools (e.g., Sisense, Tableau, Power BI, Looker), including building and maintaining dashboards, is required. Familiarity with (or ability to quickly learn) elasticube structures and AI-agent tooling. Experience working within Agile/Scrum development processes, including requirements refinement, backlog support, and release readiness. Comfortable owning ambiguity in data logic without needing everything pre-specified, while knowing when to escalate to a PM or Engineering. Strong written documentation habits, with the ability to produce clear requirements, test cases, and QA artifacts. Detail-oriented with strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, able to reconcile discrepancies across multiple data sources. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical (Engineering) and non-technical (stakeholder, customer-facing) audiences. Python experience is preferred but not required. Prior exposure to healthcare data, EMRs, or ABA-specific data (billing, scheduling, authorization, clinical session, or clinical goals domains) is preferred but not required. Process-improvement mindset, with an interest in turning recurring manual work into reusable, automated validation rules. #LI-Remote Base Salary Range $85,000—$105,000 USD Backed by Roper Technologies, Inc. (Nasdaq: ROP), CentralReach is entering an exciting phase of growth, innovation, and scale. Recognized as one of the best places to work over 10 times by organizations such as Inc, Built In, and NJBIZ, our culture is centered around impact, inclusion, and flexibility. As a hybrid company with collaborative offices in Ft. Lauderdale, FL; Holmdel, NJ; and Verona, Italy, we foster a workplace where top talent can thrive and make a real difference in the lives of those we serve. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive health benefits, generous PTO, 401(k) matching, and paid parental leave to our full-time employees. Our team members also enjoy hybrid work schedules, career development support, wellness programs, and opportunities to give back through CR Cares™, our community engagement initiative. Be part of a market leader driving the future of care. Explore opportunities at centralreach.com/careers . Protecting your information is important to us. Please take a moment to review our Notice of Privacy Practices for Job Applicants. Applicant-Privacy-Notice-110725 to understand how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information during the recruitment process.

items.description: Who is Tenable ? Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey! What makes Tenable such a great place to work? Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together! Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without sponsorship. We are unable to provide sponsorship for work visas of any kind at the time of hire, or at any point during employment. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, J-1, etc Your Role: As a Data Analyst in our Business Intelligence organization, you will turn operational and customer data into actionable reports and dashboards that drive business decisions. You will partner directly with internal business teams, such as sales compensation, to gather reporting requirements, document technical specifications, and build user friendly data assets. Your primary hands-on work will involve writing SQL views and building dashboards directly within Databricks using data populated by our engineering team. A key aspect of this role is context engineering, where you will add structured descriptions and metadata to tables, views, and columns so that our data is easily discoverable and accurately queried by AI tools like Claude. Additionally, you will validate report accuracy, monitor data quality, and maintain documentation of your reporting logic to ensure long-term reliability. Your Opportunity: You will have the opportunity to build and scale the business reporting layer within Databricks. You will be part of a globally distributed team of data professionals. This role is designed for someone who wants to grow their analytical skills in a collaborative, business facing environment. Leverage modern AI coding agents, such as Databricks' Genie or Claude, to assist in writing and optimizing your queries. What You'll Need: 2 to 4 years of experience in a business intelligence, reporting, or data analyst role. To be considered for this role, you must meet one of the following criteria: Hybrid schedule with the ability to commute to our Columbia, MD office three days a week, or hybrid schedule with the ability to commute to our Boston, MA office three days a week. Fundamental working proficiency in SQL, including an understanding of select statements, order of operations, joins, aggregations, and filtering. Basic to working proficiency with Databrick, a comparable lakehouse, or cloud data platform such as Snowflake. Experience building dashboards and presenting data visually using tools like Databricks native dashboards, Tableau, Power BI, or Looker. Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical business stakeholders and translate them into usable data assets. A detail oriented mindset with comfort in documenting data objects, definitions, and logic for downstream users. And Ideally: Prior experience writing table and column descriptions or metadata to support data catalogs, semantic layers, or natural language query tools. Exposure to Python or PySpark within Databricks notebooks, which will give you a significant advantage for career progression on this specific team. Familiarity with analytics engineering practices, such as dbt, or version control systems like Git. Experience working in enterprise software, SaaS, or cybersecurity environments. #LI-Hybrid #LI-LP1 This is the base pay range for this position. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, location and experience, and may fall outside of the range shown. Employees are also eligible for variable compensation in addition to base pay (commission for sales roles, bonus for non-sales roles), depending on company and individual performance. Tenable also offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefits which include: medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance; 401(k) retirement savings with company match; an employee stock purchase plan; an employee referral program; flexible spending accounts; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); education assistance; parental leave; paid time off (PTO); company-paid holidays; health and wellness events; and community programs. US Pay Range $72,500—$96,500 USD We’re committed to promoting Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) at Tenable - through all equal employment opportunity laws and regulations at the international, federal, state and local levels. If you need a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact Recruiting@Tenable.com for further assistance. Tenable Data Consent Statement Tenable is committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. Depending on your location, one or more of the following notices may apply to you: General Applicant Privacy Notice California Applicant Privacy Notice EU/EEA/UK Applicant Privacy Notice

items.description: Tiger Analytics is a fast-growing advanced analytics consulting firm. Our consultants bring deep expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning and AI. We are the trusted analytics partner for several Fortune 100 companies, enabling them to generate business value from data. Our business value and leadership has been recognized by various market research firms, including Forrester and Gartner. We are looking for top-notch talent as we continue to build the best analytics global consulting team in the world. The Power BI Architect will lead the design, strategy, and governance of the enterprise BI platform using Microsoft Power BI and the Azure ecosystem. This role involves assessing infrastructure requirements, defining best practices, guiding BI Engineers, enabling security, handling large data, and ensuring scalable, high-performing BI solutions that align with business needs. Key Requirements: Design scalable BI solutions with a focus on infrastructure, capacity, and licensing needs. Conduct capability assessments to align Power BI adoption with enterprise goals. Define and enforce Power BI governance frameworks, including security, data access, and workspace strategy. Provide effort estimations and delivery planning for BI initiatives. Design and optimize semantic/OLAP models (star schema, composite models, aggregations, dataflows) for enterprise-scale reporting. Establish and manage a central metric store for standardized KPIs and calculations. Architect and oversee dashboard/report design, ensuring scalability, usability, and consistency across business units. Partner with Azure Databricks, Synapse, and Data Lake teams to enable efficient BI consumption of large data. Collaborate with Microsoft partner teams to evaluate new capabilities and align with best practices. Define and enforce CI/CD strategies using Git, Azure DevOps, and deployment pipelines. Oversee data refresh automation, monitoring, and troubleshooting at scale. Guide and mentor BI Engineers on best practices in DAX, modeling, performance optimization, and visualization standards. Stay current on Microsoft Fabric, Power BI Premium, and emerging BI trends to future-proof the BI strategy. Qualifications & Skills: 10+ years of experience in Business Intelligence and Data Analytics, with 5+ years in Power BI architecture. Proven experience in designing scalable BI/analytics infrastructure solutions. Expertise in Power BI Premium/Fabric, DAX, Power Query (M), Tabular Models, and large semantic/OLAP models. Strong knowledge of Azure Databricks, Synapse, Data Lake, SQL Server. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines (Git, Azure DevOps, deployment pipelines). Skilled in refresh automation, monitoring, and troubleshooting large models. Strong understanding of data governance, compliance, and enterprise security frameworks. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills. Experience working with Microsoft partner teams on solution alignment and best practices. Benefits Significant career development opportunities exist as the company grows. The position offers a unique opportunity to be part of a small, fast-growing, challenging, and entrepreneurial environment, with a high degree of individual responsibility. Tiger Analytics provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law.

items.description: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. Binance is trusted by more than 320 million people in 100+ countries for its industry-leading security, transparency, trading engine speed, protections for investors, and unmatched portfolio of digital asset products and offerings from trading and finance to education, research, social good, payments, institutional services, and Web3 features. Binance is devoted to building an inclusive crypto ecosystem to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world with crypto as the fundamental means. About Binance Accelerator Program Binance Accelerator Program (BAP) is a 3-6 month internship program designed for Early Career talent to have firsthand experience in the rapidly expanding digital assets space. You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills at Binance and understand what it’s like to work at the world's leading blockchain ecosystem. As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE . Who may apply Current university students and recent graduates. *Terms of employment / engagement shall be subject to contract and local applicable laws We are looking for a motivated Product Data Analyst Intern to join our Product DA team. You will work alongside senior analysts on real product analytics projects — including conversion funnel analysis, A/B experiment evaluation, and dashboard building. This is a hands-on role where you'll gain exposure to product strategy, experiment-driven decision making, and large-scale data infrastructure. Responsibilities: Assist in building and analyzing user conversion funnels, identifying drop-off points and improvement opportunities Support A/B experiment evaluation: pull experiment data, validate cohort allocation (sanity checks), calculate uplift metrics, and summarize results Build and maintain dashboards for key product metrics (CTR, conversion rate, UV/PV) Respond to product team ad-hoc data requests — user segmentation, feature adoption tracking, campaign performance analysis Write and maintain SQL queries for scheduled data pipelines; assist in data quality monitoring Translate data findings into clear summaries and visualizations for product teams Requirements: Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's/Master's degree in a quantitative discipline (Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Data Science, or related field) Internship experience in product analytics or related data analysis roles preferred A natural curiosity to identify, investigate and explain trends and patterns in data Bilingual English/Mandarin is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Understanding of A/B testing fundamentals (hypothesis testing, p-value, confidence intervals) Strong logical thinking, attention to detail, and ability to work independently Fast learner with curiosity about product strategy and user behavior Competency in one or more of the following: SQL (able to write complex queries with CTEs, window functions, subqueries) Programming (Python/R for data manipulation) A data visualization tool (e.g. DataWind, Tableau, PowerBI) Nice to Have Experience with event tracking / behavioral analytics (Sensors, Mixpanel, GA) Familiarity with Airflow or data scheduling tools Interest in crypto/fintech industry Prior experience with large-scale data (Hive/Spark environment) Compensation Additional Information Why Binance • Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem • Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure • Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment • Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning • Competitive salary and company benefits • Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team) Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success. By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice .

items.description: Senior Data Analyst ABOUT THE COMPANY: Clari + Salesloft are building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System , enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth. With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate. Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future. THE OPPORTUNITY: At Clari + Salesloft, our Senior Data Analysts are pivotal to our company's success. You will be a leader within our fast-growing and high-performing Data & Analytics team, responsible for driving departments to monitor their performance, understand trends, and make more informed decisions. On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for owning the delivery of actionable insights that drive positive change across the business. Specifically, you will: Leverage complex datasets to identify and quantify key performance indicators. Create dashboards and data visualizations that monitor & measure success. Establish and own best practices & training materials for data-savvy users within functional departments. Be a key leader in championing the impact of data, company-wide. In addition to working with amazing colleagues who exemplify our ‘team over self’ core value, you will also have the opportunity to [EXAMPLE: sell an impactful and revolutionary software that is changing the way sellers sell.] You will have an opportunity to make a difference. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR: We are seeking a highly experienced, results-oriented Senior Data Analyst who can empower the business to make better decisions with data. We are interested in people who are equal parts analytically focused and business-driven, motivated by solving real-world problems and exploring new approaches. If you’re looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming a Senior Data Analyst is the career path for you! THE TEAM: Our Clari + Salesloft Data & Analytics team is composed of Data Analysts & Data Engineers who are all aligned on one mission: to redefine the Sales Engagement space and activate the authentic seller in all of us. The Data & Analytics team consists of passionate data engineers and analysts with a drive to enable Salesloft to make better decisions. Our team shares a few common traits: they are accountable, unafraid to experiment, and continuously learning. THE SKILL SET: 5+ years in a Data Analyst or similar role Expert-level proficiency in SQL and using it to create derivative data structures Experience with a data visualization tool (Sigma knowledge is preferred; Tableau or Looker is also a plus) Proven track record of using data to drive significant transformations in business processes Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to distill complex ideas and present them with influence to non-data focused individuals and leadership. Past experience in a SaaS business model is preferred Experience using dbt/Python/R/Git is a plus Proficient in AI model implementation or highly motivated to develop expertise in the field At Clari + Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us! #LI-Remote Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Clari + Salesloft will come from an @ clari.com or @ salesloft.com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Clari + Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page . We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment — all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.

items.description: About Carrot : Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com . The Opportunity Carrot is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our BI function as it scales to meet, and anticipate, the needs of the organization and its clients. This is an executional role providing essential analytics support across the company: you will gather requirements, field ad hoc and recurring data requests, and build the reporting dashboards that leaders across Carrot rely on to make decisions. You will work hands-on with modern data tooling, including SQL, dbt, and enterprise BI platforms, and partner with teams across the business to translate their questions into clear, trustworthy answers. The BI team is highly cross-functional and sits alongside Data Engineering, making this a strong opportunity to sharpen technical skills while building broad business context in a mission-driven environment. What You’ll Own In this role, you will: Design and build data models in SQL with a focus on correctness, clarity, and reusability Build and maintain dashboards and reports that track key business metrics and inform decision-making across the company Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer high-priority business questions from stakeholders across the organization Collaborate with teams across Carrot to understand their data domains, reporting needs, and success metrics Contribute to data quality, documentation, and self-service BI capabilities as the function scales What Success Looks Like In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Delivered accurate, well-documented dashboards and reports that stakeholders across the company trust and use regularly Fully ramped on Carrot's data stack and core data domains, independently owning recurring and ad hoc reporting requests Built strong working relationships with cross-functional partners and established yourself as a reliable analytics resource Improved turnaround and consistency of reporting by creating reusable data models and reducing manual work About You ✨ You likely have: A Bachelor's Degree Intermediate-to-advanced SQL experience: ability to write advanced queries using joins, common table expressions, and window/analytic functions Experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Looker, DOMO, or Power BI) to bring data insights to life for broad audiences Basic statistics proficiency: experiment design, hypothesis testing, statistical significance, probability, and distributions Ability to translate business intelligence needs from a variety of stakeholders into technical execution and clear presentation Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical information to non-technical audiences Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Experience using dbt to transform, test, and document data Experience working with healthcare industry data or in other complex, regulated data environments Experience in a high-growth environment Familiarity with version control systems (Git preferred) Understanding of effective data modeling strategies and implementations Why This Role Matters Data is central to how Carrot operates and grows. Leaders across the company depend on accurate, timely reporting to serve members, support customers, and make sound business decisions. As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will be the connective tissue between raw data and those decisions, ensuring the organization runs on insights it can trust. Your work directly supports Carrot's mission of expanding access to fertility and family-building care worldwide. Better data means better decisions for the members and customers who rely on Carrot every day. Interview Process We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team. For this role, candidates can expect: Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes Performance Task — 60 minutes Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role. Why Candidates Join Carrot Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission. Highlights include: A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally. A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge. Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits. A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture. The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide. Compensation Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $98,000.00- $125,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. items.title: Payments Data Analyst
items.summary: Our team is developing a payment gateway for accepting funds from users on behalf of merchants, as well as sending funds from merchants to users.
items.description: Our team is developing a payment gateway for accepting funds from users on behalf of merchants, as well as sending funds from merchants to users. The system involves storing user payment data and is subject to PCI DSS compliance. It contains multiple integrations with payment systems, providers, and other gateways and processors, including 3DS.We're looking for a Payments Data Analyst to join our Product team and transform payment and product data into actionable insights that improve merchant success, platform performance, and business decisions. As a Payments Data Analyst, you will be a strategic partner to the Product, Merchant Solutions, Processor Integrations, and ML teams, helping drive data-informed decisions across our payment platform. You will analyze payment performance, identify trends and optimization opportunities, evaluate the impact of product initiatives, and provide recommendations that improve approval rates, payment efficiency, and merchant experience. Job Responsibilities: Monitor, analyze, and optimize payment performance across merchants, processors, payment methods, and markets. Analyze approval rates, decline patterns, payment routing performance, retry and cascading effectiveness, 3DS performance, and transaction success. Perform deep-dive analyses to identify trends, anomalies, and optimization opportunities across processors, card schemes, BINs, countries, merchants, and payment methods. Measure the impact of new product features, processor integrations, routing changes, payment optimization initiatives, and A/B experiments. Build and maintain dashboards and reports that provide actionable insights for Product, Merchant Solutions, Executive, and other business teams. Define, monitor, and improve key product and payment KPIs. Investigate merchant and processor performance to identify root causes and recommend improvements. Collaborate with Product Managers to support product discovery, feature prioritization, and success measurement. Work closely with Solution Engineers, Integration Analysts, and the ML Specialist to improve payment performance and operational efficiency. Support continuous monitoring of payment performance by identifying anomalies, emerging trends, and opportunities for optimization. Present analytical findings and recommendations in a clear, business-oriented manner to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Requirements You’ll thrive here if you have 4+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Product Analyst, Payments Analyst, or in a similar analytical role. Advanced SQL skills, including complex queries and window functions. Experience with BI tools such as Metabase, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar. Experience with Python (Pandas, Jupyter Notebook) for data analysis. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Experience working with large datasets. Ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations. Nice to Have Experience in FinTech, Payments, SaaS, or E-commerce. Understanding of payment processing, payment orchestration, or PSP integrations. Knowledge of payment routing, retries, cascading, and 3DS authentication. Familiarity with payment KPIs such as approval rate, conversion rate, authorization rate, and decline analysis. Understanding of fraud-related metrics, chargebacks, RDR, and risk signals. Experience working with product analytics, experimentation, and feature adoption metrics. Basic understanding of Machine Learning concepts. Conditions We know that great talent deserves great conditions, so here’s what you can expect when joining us: Full remote work. Competitive compensation with a service contract. Transparent performance reviews twice a year, with bonus opportunities and salary adjustments. An annual allowance that you can use for home office improvements, sports activities, equipment upgrades, and more—tailor it to what benefits you most. Investment in your development: paid language courses, access to various learning platforms, and a mindfulness benefit, including psychological support with 50% coverage. Career growth in a fast-scaling project with opportunities to influence technical decisions. A culture of recognition: our peer reward program celebrates contributions from across the team. This opportunity is also available for those who already live in Limassol, Cyprus. EU-based employment contract and a 3-year Cyprus work visa. Private medical insurance for you and your family, a corporate mobile plan (unlimited in Cyprus with roaming included), and interest-free support for car purchases. 50% coverage of school and kindergarten fees for your children. Fully covered sports benefits, and also access to in-house electric scooters and bike rentals. A fully equipped office in Limassol’s city center, with everything you need for deep work and collaboration. Free catering in the office and an in-house coffee bar with high-quality drinks and a health bar stocked with nutritious snacks. Benefits are provided in accordance with the company’s policies and eligibility criteria. Recruitment process HR interview (40 min); Technical interview (1 hour); Final interview (1 hour); Recommendations check; Job Offer. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: CerebriOS is a software company building B2B SaaS products that help businesses make better decisions, streamline operations, and get more value from their data. Our products combine practical business workflows with intuitive technology designed for everyday use. We bring together technology, data, and business expertise to create solutions that are scalable, reliable, and easy to use. We are looking for a Data Analyst to transform business data into clear, actionable insights. You will partner with teams across the organization to define metrics, create reporting, and investigate questions that affect customers and business performance. WHAT YOU WILL DO Gather and analyze data from multiple sources. Write SQL queries and validate the accuracy of results. Build dashboards and recurring reports. Define and document business metrics. Investigate trends, anomalies, and performance changes. Translate analysis into practical recommendations. Present findings to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Improve data quality and reporting processes. Support experiments, forecasting, and operational planning as needed. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR 2+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field. Strong SQL and spreadsheet skills. Experience with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or a similar platform. Understanding of descriptive statistics and data visualization. Ability to communicate complex findings clearly. Strong attention to data accuracy and detail. NICE TO HAVE Experience with Python or R. Familiarity with data warehouses and analytics engineering. Knowledge of experimentation, product analytics, or forecasting. Experience working in technology or consumer-facing platforms. COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS $70,000–$95,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications. CerebriOS offers a remote-first work environment, opportunities to work with business and product data, and a collaborative culture focused on turning data into practical business outcomes. HIRING PROCESS Application review → recruiter screen → technical/SQL exercise → final stakeholder interview → offer. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY CerebriOS is an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity and consider qualified candidates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Location: Remote Salary Range: 70,000 - 95,000 USD (gross, annually) Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: We are seeking a Data Analyst & Power BI Coordinator to join the Global Sales Operations team. This position will demand a high-level understanding of the technology, process and procedures that support a successful Sales Operations organization. This Analyst will focus primarily on data infrastructure within Power BI and report building within Power BI, utilizing data integrations from Snowflake, SQL, as well as other internal tools. items.title: Impact & Insights Officer
items.summary: Media Development Investment Fund (MDIF) is seeking an Impact & Insights Officer to help measure, understand and communicate the impact of our global investments across public interest information companies.
items.description: Media Development Investment Fund (MDIF) is seeking an Impact & Insights Officer to help measure, understand and communicate the impact of our global investments across public interest information companies. This role sits at the intersection of data analysis, monitoring & evaluation, and strategic insight. You will play a key role in transforming data into clear, compelling narratives that support decision-making, strengthen impact, and demonstrate value to donors, investors, and stakeholders. If you believe in data as a force for good and are passionate about using insights to support independent media and information businesses worldwide, we encourage you to apply by the deadline of September 30, 2026. We are seeking one candidate based in Europe. Offers of engagement are contingent on MDIF’s ability to contract in the successful candidate’s country of residence in accordance with applicable local law. Key Responsibilities Maintain and enhance MDIF’s impact measurement framework and underlying data systems. Collect, analyze, and visualize data across a global portfolio; develop dashboards and reporting tools. Produce quarterly and annual impact reports for internal and external audiences. Standardize data collection processes and ensure data quality across teams and partners. Monitor sector trends and translate findings into actionable insights. Analyze communications and content performance; support storytelling through data. Contribute to fundraising by providing data-driven insights and impact narratives. Requirements Minimum 2 years of experience in impact measurement, data analysis or monitoring and evaluation. Bachelor’s degree in social sciences, public policy, data science, statistics, economics, political science or related field; or equivalent experience. Strong analytical skills with experience in quantitative and qualitative data analysis. Demonstrated proficiency with data tools, including SQL, at least one business intelligence or data visualization tool such as Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent, Python or R, and Excel. Familiarity with MEL frameworks, survey tools, and analytics platforms (e.g. Google Analytics). Ability to translate complex data into clear insights for diverse audiences. Fluency in spoken and written English. Alignment with MDIF’s mission and interest in independent media. What We Offer Meaningful work supporting independent media globally. A pathway to growth and increased responsibility. A collaborative, international, and mission-driven work environment. Professional development support and long-term growth opportunities. About MDIF Media Development Investment Fund (MDIF) is the only non profit impact investment fund dedicated to supporting independent media and information ventures. To Apply: Please submit your CV along with responses to the pre-screening questions by September 30, 2026. Applications must be submitted in English. We strongly encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. MDIF is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion in its hiring practices. If you meet most of the requirements and are excited about the role, we encourage you to apply. Heavily AI-generated resumes are less likely to be reviewed favorably. *Note on Screening Questions Responses to Questions 5 - 7 are requested solely for the purpose of evaluating candidates’ analytical approach, problem-solving capabilities, and communication skills as part of the recruitment process. These submissions will not be used, reproduced, or applied by MDIF for any operational, commercial, or external purposes. In the event of hire, and only with the candidate’s prior consent, exemplary responses may be referenced or further developed within the scope of the role. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life.
items.description: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at . The Opportunity 🚀 Carrot is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our BI function as it scales to meet, and anticipate, the needs of the organization and its clients. This is an executional role providing essential analytics support across the company: you will gather requirements, field ad hoc and recurring data requests, and build the reporting dashboards that leaders across Carrot rely on to make decisions. You will work hands-on with modern data tooling, including SQL, dbt, and enterprise BI platforms, and partner with teams across the business to translate their questions into clear, trustworthy answers. The BI team is highly cross-functional and sits alongside Data Engineering, making this a strong opportunity to sharpen technical skills while building broad business context in a mission-driven environment. What You’ll Own 💼 In this role, you will: Design and build data models in SQL with a focus on correctness, clarity, and reusability Build and maintain dashboards and reports that track key business metrics and inform decision-making across the company Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer high-priority business questions from stakeholders across the organization Collaborate with teams across Carrot to understand their data domains, reporting needs, and success metrics Contribute to data quality, documentation, and self-service BI capabilities as the function scales What Success Looks Like 📈 In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Delivered accurate, well-documented dashboards and reports that stakeholders across the company trust and use regularly Fully ramped on Carrot's data stack and core data domains, independently owning recurring and ad hoc reporting requests Built strong working relationships with cross-functional partners and established yourself as a reliable analytics resource Improved turnaround and consistency of reporting by creating reusable data models and reducing manual work About You ✨ You likely have: A Bachelor's Degree Intermediate-to-advanced SQL experience: ability to write advanced queries using joins, common table expressions, and window/analytic functions Experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Looker, DOMO, or Power BI) to bring data insights to life for broad audiences Basic statistics proficiency: experiment design, hypothesis testing, statistical significance, probability, and distributions Ability to translate business intelligence needs from a variety of stakeholders into technical execution and clear presentation Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical information to non-technical audiences Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Experience using dbt to transform, test, and document data Experience working with healthcare industry data or in other complex, regulated data environments Experience in a high-growth environment Familiarity with version control systems (Git preferred) Understanding of effective data modeling strategies and implementations Why This Role Matters 🧡 Data is central to how Carrot operates and grows. Leaders across the company depend on accurate, timely reporting to serve members, support customers, and make sound business decisions. As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will be the connective tissue between raw data and those decisions, ensuring the organization runs on insights it can trust. Your work directly supports Carrot's mission of expanding access to fertility and family-building care worldwide. Better data means better decisions for the members and customers who rely on Carrot every day. Interview Process 🤝 We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team. For this role, candidates can expect: Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes Performance Task — 60 minutes Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role. Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍 Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission. Highlights include: A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally. A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge. Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits. A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture. The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide. Compensation 💰 Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $98,000.00- $125,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. items.title: KPI Architect
items.summary: The KPI Architect Role in Exelab’s Tailor-Made SolutionsAt Exelab, we don’t sell a single off-the-shelf product – we build custom, innovative solutions that directly target our clients’ unique business objectives.
items.description: The KPI Architect Role in Exelab’s Tailor-Made Solutions At Exelab, we don’t sell a single off-the-shelf product – we build custom, innovative solutions that directly target our clients’ unique business objectives. Each client engagement is essentially treated as a mini product development cycle: we start from a specific business goal or problem and craft a tailor-made solution (which might involve software, AI models, systems integration, etc.) to deliver measurable business impact. In Exelab’s methodological framework, performance and measurability of results become central elements of every project. The KPI Architect is the cross-functional figure who ensures rigor, consistency, and depth in performance analysis across all Value projects – the high-impact strategic initiatives at the core of Exelab’s offering. This role is not a traditional data analyst: it's a professional who combines advanced analytical skills with deep business understanding. Someone who knows that numbers tell stories, but only when you ask the right questions. The mission : ensure every project starts with clear objectives, defined measurement criteria, and a monitoring system that reveals whether actions are generating expected impact. The KPI Architect operates across multiple projects, intervening during discovery phases to define measurement frameworks, supporting Value Builders on complex analytical challenges, and verifying the impact of deployed solutions. Reporting directly to the General Manager, maintain an overview of performance across the entire project portfolio. In day-to-day operations, Value Builders must be autonomous in analyzing their project data. The KPI Architect intervenes when defining methodological frameworks, tackling complex analytical challenges, or ensuring client alignment on success criteria. Key Responsibilities The KPI Architect will ensure measurability and objectivity across our AI-enabled solutions. Core responsibilities include: Measurement Framework Definition: Collaborate with Value Builders and Project Managers during discovery phases to define how each project’s success will be measured. Translate vague business objectives into concrete, measurable, and actionable KPIs. Establish baselines, targets, and evaluation criteria that enable objective determination of whether an initiative has generated value. Create reusable templates and methodologies that accelerate this phase on future projects. Client Alignment on Objectives: Facilitate structured conversations with clients to ensure clarity and alignment on success criteria. Clients often have implicit or poorly defined expectations: the KPI Architect makes them explicit, quantifies them, and transforms them into shared agreements. This alignment prevents misunderstandings and creates the foundation for partnerships based on objective results. Complex Analytical Challenge Support: Intervene when Value Builders face analytical problems requiring specialized skills or advanced methodologies. This may involve multi-touch attribution analysis, predictive modeling, advanced segmentation, or interpretation of particularly complex datasets. Bring methodological expertise and work directly on the data alongside the Value Builder. Solution Impact Verification: After deployment, dive into the data to verify whether solutions are generating expected impact. Build the analyses personally, distinguish correlations from causality, identify confounding variables, and build rigorous analyses that enable correct attribution of results. When numbers don’t add up, propose course corrections based on concrete evidence. Purpose-Driven Analysis: Every analysis has a clear purpose and consequent action. Don’t produce reports for the sake of producing them: every insight must translate into a decision or action. Know when data is sufficient to decide and when deeper investigation is needed. Avoid analysis paralysis while maintaining focus on business value. Knowledge Building & Methodological Standards: Build and maintain Exelab’s analytical standards. Document methodologies, create templates, develop best practices that enable the organization to continuously improve analysis quality. Train Value Builders on fundamental analytical competencies, raising the team’s overall level. Portfolio View & Pattern Recognition: Thanks to the cross-functional position, identify patterns emerging across multiple projects. Recognize recurring problems, reusable solutions, reference benchmarks. This portfolio view feeds Exelab’s knowledge base and accelerates future projects. In summary, the KPI Architect is the guardian of measurability and objectivity at Exelab. This role ensures every project starts with clear objectives, proceeds with rigorous monitoring, and concludes with impact verification. The work transforms the promise of "measurable value" from a marketing claim into demonstrable reality. Requirements Ideal Candidate Profile – Skills and Experience Our ideal candidate is a professional with a rare combination: technical excellence in data analysis combined with deep understanding of business dynamics . It’s not enough to know how to manipulate data – you need to know which questions to ask and how to translate answers into valuable actions. Below are the key characteristics and qualifications we expect: Advanced Analytical Skills: Mastery of data analysis tools and methodologies: SQL, Python/R for statistical analysis, BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI). Comfort with statistical analysis: significance testing, regression analysis, cohort analysis, A/B testing methodology. Ability to work with large datasets and heterogeneous sources. Experience building dashboards and monitoring systems. Business Acumen & Strategic Orientation: Deep understanding of how businesses work and which metrics truly matter. Experience with KPIs typical of customer-facing contexts: conversion rate, customer acquisition cost, lifetime value, churn, NPS. Ability to link operational metrics to financial impact. Skill in translating vague business objectives into concrete, measurable indicators. Critical Thinking & Methodological Rigor: Scientific approach to analysis: formulate hypotheses, test them, evaluate evidence with constructive skepticism. Distinguish correlation from causality and identify biases and confounding variables. Don’t settle for the first interpretation: dig until finding the correct explanation. At the same time, know when data is “good enough” to decide. Communication & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional ability to communicate complex insights clearly and actionably. Adapt the message to the audience: executive summary for C-level, methodological detail for technical teams. Skill in facilitating difficult conversations about success criteria, managing expectations and building alignment. Consulting or Multi-Project Experience: Background in environments involving multiple projects/clients in parallel. May come from consulting firms, agencies, or analytics roles in strongly data-oriented companies. Experience across diverse contexts develops pattern recognition and adaptability. Familiarity with CRM and marketing technology is a significant plus. Autonomy & Proactivity: Ability to operate with minimal supervision, proactively identifying where their intervention can create value. Don’t wait for problems to arrive: anticipate analytical needs and step forward. Manage own time across multiple projects, prioritizing based on impact. AI Openness & Continuous Learning: Willingness to learn and use AI tools to enhance analytical activities. Intellectual curiosity and drive for continuous improvement. Data analysis evolves rapidly: we’re looking for someone who embraces this change as opportunity. Native Italian and at least B2-level English required. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Marketing Data Analyst
items.summary: We are looking for a Marketing Data Analyst to join the Marketing team at MD Finance.
items.description: We are looking for a Marketing Data Analyst to join the Marketing team at MD Finance . In this role, you will help us move from manual reporting and reactive analysis to reliable data, faster decisions, and forward-looking growth planning. The position combines technical data ownership with business analysis: from collecting data through APIs, exports, tracking systems, and internal sources to cleaning, transforming, validating, visualizing, and turning it into clear recommendations. If you enjoy building clean data foundations and turning complex marketing performance into decisions that directly influence CAC, new-deal volume, and channel scale, we'd love to see how you can contribute to our growth. Main Responsibilities: Own the end-to-end marketing data flow, including ingestion, transformation logic, data cleanup, quality assurance, dashboarding, analysis, and documentation. - Create and maintain a single source of truth for marketing decisions, connecting campaign performance, customer quality, funnel results, and business outcomes. - Set up and maintain offline conversion uploads to Google, Meta, and other advertising platforms so campaigns can optimize toward verified business results. - Own affiliate measurement, including postback API setup, conversion tracking, and complete reporting on leads, applications, approvals, new deals, repayments, and payouts. - Collect and structure marketing costs across all channels, with accurate CAC, ROI, and ROMI reporting by campaign, source, partner, keyword, landing page, source ID, and creative. Improve and standardize cross-channel attribution, and synchronize Singular data with internal dashboards, BI reports, and marketing visualizations. - Build and maintain product and marketing dashboards covering acquisition, funnel performance, user behavior, conversion rates, repayment behavior, campaign quality, and customer value. - Create a complete website and product tagging framework, visualize every key funnel step, and clearly separate new and repeat deals across channels, campaigns, affiliates, and traffic sources. - Support landing-page experiments and A/B tests by defining tracking, measuring results, analyzing performance, and recommending what should be improved, stopped, or scaled. - Help the team launch and evaluate marketing tests across campaigns, creatives, landing pages, sources, keywords, and traffic segments. - Analyze customer and traffic quality at keyword, landing-page, source-ID, creative, campaign, affiliate, and channel level. - Build cohort and repayment analyses to track retention, repeat usage, repayment patterns, risk signals, customer value, and long-term quality by acquisition source. - Deliver ROI/ROMI and LTV/CAC analyses that support budget allocation, channel scaling, and commercial planning. - Create dedicated SEO reporting with brand and non-brand traffic splits, plus separate dashboards for satellite websites and projects. - Take full ownership of the Marketing planning workbook: automate recurring work, improve its structure, and reduce manual effort and human error. - Work closely with Marketing, Product, IT, Affiliate, and Risk teams to keep data reliable, accessible, and useful for daily decisions. Expected Results: Establish reliable marketing reporting that serves as the trusted basis for daily, channel, and management decisions. - Reduce CAC and increase new-deal volume by identifying and scaling the campaigns, partners, and traffic segments that bring the highest-quality customers. - Improve budget allocation through consistent attribution, cost, repayment-quality, ROI/ROMI, and LTV/CAC analysis. - Reduce manual reporting, human error, traffic-launch delays, and Marketing's dependency on IT for recurring data tasks. - Enable faster, more structured experimentation with clear measurement and actionable recommendations. Professional Qualifications: 4+ years of experience in marketing analytics, performance analytics, product analytics, or a similar role. - Strong SQL skills and the ability to work confidently with large datasets. - Strong Python skills for automation, data cleaning, API integrations, and recurring reporting tasks. - Comfortable owning the full path from raw data to business decision: ingestion, transformation, cleanup, validation, dashboarding, analysis, and recommendation. - Hands-on experience with BI and visualization tools such as Power BI, Metabase, Looker Studio, Tableau, or similar. - Practical experience with marketing and tracking tools such as Singular, Google Ads and Google APIs, Meta Ads, GA4, GTM, Affise, affiliate platforms, postbacks, and ad-platform conversion tracking. - Experience building attribution logic, funnel reporting, cohort analysis, CAC/ROI/ROMI reporting, and LTV/CAC analysis. - Ability to move from campaign-level reporting into keyword, creative, landing-page, source-ID, affiliate, and channel-level quality analysis. - Strong business communication skills and the ability to translate complex analysis into clear actions for technical and non-technical stakeholders. - FinTech experience is a significant advantage, especially in lending, repayments, repeat customers, or risk-related marketing analysis. What We Offer: Join a fast-scaling FinTech company where your decisions shape the business and your contributions truly matter. - Enjoy 20 paid days off annually, flexible scheduling, and a supportive, people-first culture. - Partial compensation for medical insurance, sports activities, and foreign language. - Work in an international, agile team with ambitious goals, modern tools, and a strong sense of purpose. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: At Finyard , we’re a global team of engineers, data scientists, marketeers, and financial experts, passionate about technology and innovation. We’re all about bringing revolutionary software services to people all around the world, and have been since 2018. Our mission is to innovate by launching modern software solutions in the FinTech space, giving users around the world simpler and quicker ways to transact and manage their investments. We are committed to ensuring every product we release is in service of our users, so that as we grow, so do they. We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our Data Office and be allocated to the Product domain . You will partner closely with Product, Commercial, and Engineering teams to understand user behaviour, evaluate and generate product hypotheses, design and analyse experiments, improve key business and product metrics, and build scalable analytics foundations such as metrics, data marts, dashboards, and alerting. Key responsibilities Product analytics & insights Analyse user behaviour and product journeys across web and mobile applications: funnels, activation, engagement, retention, monetisation, and feature adoption. Identify drop-offs, behavioural patterns, friction points, and growth opportunities and translate them into actionable product hypotheses. Evaluate the impact of product launches and changes and explain what changed, why it changed, and for whom . Experimentation & hypotheses Work with the Product team to formulate and prioritise hypotheses and define measurable success criteria. Design and analyse A/B tests and other experiments , including primary metrics, guardrails, sample-size considerations, segmentation, and statistical interpretation. Ensure experiment results are translated into clear product decisions and next steps , not just statistical conclusions. Metrics & product monitoring Define and maintain product KPIs and metric trees , ensuring consistent definitions across teams. Develop dashboards and analytical views that help Product teams understand performance without relying on manual analysis. Segmentation & behavioural research Build meaningful user and behavioural segmentations based on lifecycle stage, product usage, engagement, monetisation, and other relevant characteristics. Analyse differences between user cohorts and segments to understand which product experiences work for whom . Data foundations & analytics quality Formulate analytical and business requirements and actively participate in building product data marts and single-source-of-truth datasets . Partner with Engineering and Data Engineering on event tracking and instrumentation , ensuring new features generate reliable and useful analytical data. Improve the product metrics system , including definitions, documentation, ownership, and consistency. What we expect (must-have) 3+ years of experience in data analytics (fintech/product experience is a strong plus). Strong SQL+Python and hands-on experience working with large datasets. Strong understanding of product analytics concepts : funnels, conversion, retention, cohorts, engagement, monetisation, and segmentation. Hands-on experience with A/B testing and experiment analysis , including statistical significance, confidence intervals, guardrail metrics, and common sources of bias. Experience with product analytics tooling and event-based tracking. Ability to communicate insights clearly and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders. Advanced Russian and English Nice-to-have Experience building analytical data marts or working with dbt-style analytics engineering workflows. Experience owning event tracking across web and mobile applications. Understanding of marketing analytics, acquisition, and attribution. Our technological stack Databases: Snowflake, ClickHouse, MySQL, BigQuery Visualisation systems: Tableau, HEX Analytics tools: Amplitude Programming language: Python (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn) Interactive environments: Jupyter Notebook, HEX Originally posted on Himalayas

We're past the phase of standing up basic reporting — we're now building a modern, agentic analytics practice, including Lighthouse, our internal BI-as-code platform, where dashboards, metrics, and semantic definitions live in version-controlled code rather than scattered across disconnected tools. This role is a chance to shape that next chapter. You'll partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and CS leaders to answer their hardest questions about pipeline, funnel conversion, campaign performance, and retention, while helping build the infrastructure and AI-forward workflows that let the whole GTM org get trustworthy answers faster. You'll report to our Senior Manager of Analytics and work in tight, two-week sprints alongside Analytics Engineering, so you'll see your work ship and get used — fast. What You'll Do GTM Analysis & Decision Support Deliver decision-ready analysis across Sales, Marketing, and Client Success: pipeline health, funnel conversion, campaign and channel performance, cohort/retention, and GRR/NRR drivers. Partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and CSM stakeholders to scope questions, frame recommendations, and see analysis through to a decision — not just a dashboard handoff. Bring structure to ambiguous asks — translate a stakeholder's question into a clear, testable analytical approach. Data Modeling & Quality Build and maintain dbt models and marts for Sales, Marketing, and CS domains, with Salesforce as a core source system. Own data quality and documentation for your domain: clear definitions, source-of-truth tables, and QA that stakeholders can trust without double-checking. Lighthouse & Agentic Analytics Contribute to Lighthouse, our BI-as-code platform, as we build it out — help define how dashboards, metrics, and semantic models get written, versioned, and reviewed like software. Note: Lighthouse is an active build, not a finished platform — you'll be shaping it, not just using it. Push our analytics workflows toward agentic AI: using AI agents to accelerate analysis, automate recurring reporting, and cut down on manual, one-off dashboard requests. Bring a point of view on where AI can replace manual analyst work versus where it can't — you should be as comfortable prompting and evaluating an agent as writing the SQL yourself. How You'll Work Operate in two-week sprints, planning and prioritizing your own backlog against team OKRs alongside your manager. Give clear, proactive status updates to stakeholders rather than waiting to be asked. What We're Looking For Experience 5+ years in analytics/BI, with meaningful time supporting Sales, Marketing, or Customer Success functions at a fast-growing company. Staff-level candidates should bring deeper scope — larger or more ambiguous problems owned end-to-end, and a track record of setting technical direction, not just executing against it. Expert SQL and hands-on dbt experience modeling GTM data. Comfortable with Python for analysis and automation — this isn't a heavy ML/stats role, but you know how to script your way out of manual work. Experience with Salesforce as a data source — you understand CRM objects, fields, and the quirks of modeling data. Familiarity with a modern data stack: Fivetran or similar EL tooling, and a cloud warehouse (we run Snowflake; BigQuery experience also welcome). BI & AI Fluency Experience with at least one modern BI tool (Sigma, Hex, Tableau, Looker, or similar) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement — what matters more is that you understand how modern BI organizations operate: governed semantic layers, self-serve dashboards, and BI-as-code approaches. Genuine curiosity about agentic analytics — you've used AI agents or LLM tools to speed up analysis, and you want to help define what that looks like at scale. We build with Claude day-to-day, so hands-on experience with Claude Code (or a similar coding agent like Codex) is a big plus — you'll use it to move faster on dbt models, scripting, and analysis, not just as a novelty. Mindset Strong communicator who can frame a recommendation clearly for a non-technical stakeholder and defend it under questioning. Comfortable with the accountability of owning a deliverable through to closure, not just the analysis in the middle. Energized by ambiguity and fast iteration — two-week sprints mean you'll ship early and often. Compensation Additional Information Join us in shaping the future of real estate The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages. We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition. Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date. More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner. Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform. Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.
