items.description: Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences. Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta. About the role: As a founding Strategic Sales Director for Iberia, you will own 8-12 of the largest strategic accounts across Spain and/or Portugal — IBEX35-caliber banking, telco, insurance, utilities, and travel enterprises. You'll run complex, multi-level sales cycles from 6 to 18 months, build both the business case and the technical win alongside your Solutions Consultant, and drive long-term land-and-expand strategy while continuing to bring in new logos. As part of the founding Iberia team, you'll work alongside a 10-person Madrid-based org (SDR, SC, and Customer Success) and help shape the region's go-to-market strategy from the ground up. Responsibilities: Manage a portfolio of 8-12 top strategic accounts in Spain and/or Portugal Generate your own pipeline — Cresta drives strong inbound, but Strategic AEs are expected to self-source roughly 50% of pipeline Orchestrate complex, multi-level sales cycles (6-18 months) across buying committees, procurement, legal, and security Build the business case and the technical win in partnership with your Solutions Consultant and extended team Drive land-and-expand strategy with a long-term vision for each account, while continuing to prioritize new-logo acquisition Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and Engineering to deliver an exceptional customer experience Qualifications We Value: 8+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, including at least 4 years as a quota-carrying individual contributor selling into large Spanish enterprises (IBEX35 or equivalent: banking, telco, insurance, utilities, travel) Verified track record closing deals of €500K+ ARR / €1M+ TCV, including at least one deal exceeding €1M TCV at an IBEX35-caliber account New-logo hunting as your primary motion — majority of attainment historically from net-new logos rather than installed-base expansion Experience navigating complex 6-18 month cycles, including RFPs, buying committees, and procurement/legal/security review in regulated industries Existing C-level/VP network within Spanish enterprise accounts Nice-to-Have: CX / contact center / conversational AI domain exposure (CCaaS, WEM, analytics, virtual agents) Experience opening a market or territory from zero for a hyper-growth vendor Experience co-selling with SIs and channel partners (e.g. Accenture, Telefónica Tech, Sabio-type ecosystem) Familiarity with Ley SAC and Spanish regulatory drivers in customer service MEDDPICC (or equivalent) formally trained Language & Travel: Native or negotiation-grade Spanish, fluent English; Portuguese is a strong plus Madrid-based, with travel across the Iberian Peninsula expected Perks & Benefits: We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced Compensation at Cresta Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table. The posted base salary range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family. This role is variable target compensation eligible. There is potential to exceed target earnings when goals are surpassed. OTE Range: TBD (comp benchmarking in progress) + Offers Equity We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Cresta employee, reach out to recruiting@cresta.ai

items.description: Requisition #: 18836 Functional Area: Consulting; Workplace Safety Employment Type: Independent Contractor Work Options: Independent Contractor - varies based on Scope of Work #LI-Remote Work Hours: As needed to fulfill contract requirements Posting J. J. Keller & Associates, Inc. is a North American organization providing innovative safety and regulatory compliance guidance and solutions to organizations across the U. S. and Canada. For over 70 years, organizations of all sizes have relied on J. J. Keller to help them create safe work environments for their employees and comply with ever-changing regulations. As we look to expand our service offerings, we are seeking to add an Independent Contractor to our Workplace Safety Consulting practice who has subject matter expertise related to OSHA General Industry . This opportunity is for an Independent Contractor only and does not constitute an employment relationship. Independent Contractors must reside in the U. S. and be legally authorized to perform services within the United States. To be considered as an Independent Contractor, individuals must: Operate as an independent safety consulting business (e.g., sole proprietor, incorporated entity, or equivalent) Provide services to multiple clients and maintain a non-exclusive consulting practice Supply their own tools, methodologies, instructional materials, and business processes necessary to deliver services Be responsible for all taxes, insurance, and business-related expenses Provide their own computer, equipment, and tools necessary to perform services Maintain appropriate professional liability coverage, as required under the contractual agreement Travel requirements vary based on client engagements, audit needs, and training delivery, and are defined by project or statement of work. Types of Services Requested Provides expert advice, safety consulting and educational services to J. J. Keller clients on construction safety and health matters through onsite engagements, off-site locations, and/or internet-based delivery methods in accordance with defined project scope. Designs, develops, documents, and maintains training curriculum and instructional materials for general and client-specific applications. Conducts safety audits, inspections, and risk assessments, based on applicable regulatory standards and client requirements related to excavation, fall protection, scaffolding, trenching, heavy equipment, electrical safety, and roadway work zones. Monitors relevant regulatory and compliance applicable to the scope of service and incorporate changes into deliverables and training content as appropriate. items.title: Senior Data Scientist - Real-Time Esports Predictions (m/f/x)
items.summary: (100% remote, anywhere in Europe) Are you excited about building ML systems that make predictions in real-time?
items.description: (100% remote, anywhere in Europe) Are you excited about building ML systems that make predictions in real-time? Are you driven by building things end-to-end, from research to live systems? At GRID , we are building real-time prediction systems for competitive esports (CS2, Dota 2, League of Legends). Our models power live betting markets, producing continuously updated win probabilities, handicap lines, over/under totals, and specialty markets during matches. We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to lead the research, design, and continuous improvement of our core predictive models. You will be the driving force behind the math, statistical logic, and feature engineering that make our models highly accurate and profitable. You will tackle complex problems in high-frequency data, design rigorous backtesting frameworks, and work on bridging theoretical research and live product features. Requirements What you will do Lead Model R&D: Design, build, and optimise the machine learning models and statistical frameworks that power our real-time odds and betting markets. Advanced Feature Engineering: Extract deep predictive signals from raw, high-frequency esports telemetry, turning complex in-game mechanics into structured modelling features. Build state-of-the-art models: Focus on model performance and probability calibration. Design rigorous backtesting frameworks to prevent data leakage and evaluate performance against historical market baselines. Develop Market Logic: Create the mathematical rules and probabilistic derivations that translate baseline win probabilities into complex derivative markets (handicaps, totals, player props). Deploy real-time production systems: Ensure your models are seamlessly translated into production-grade pipelines and microservices. Your skills will include Required Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in data science, quantitative research, or statistical modelling. Advanced Mathematical Foundations: Deep, intuitive understanding of probability, statistics, and machine learning theory. Advanced Python Proficiency: Expert-level skills in the Python data stack. You write clean, production-grade code. Evaluation Expertise: Proven experience designing complex backtesting environments and defining custom evaluation metrics for unique business problems. Nice to Have Esports Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of competitive esports (CS2, Dota 2, LoL), the underlying game mechanics, and the competitive meta. High-Frequency/Real-Time Data: Experience modeling off streaming data or data that updates continuously over time. Software Engineering Basics: Understanding of modern MLOps principles and experience with tools like MLFlow, Airflow, etc. Highlights Passionate about real-time ML and esports? Join GRID as a Senior Data Scientist! Lead research and build predictive models powering live betting odds for CS2, Dota 2, and LoL. Apply now! Originally posted on Himalayas

Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. items.description: Are you knowledgeable about investments and eager to shape the future of AI? With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can help improve financial literacy, strengthen portfolio analysis, and support investors and analysts worldwide. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI. We’re looking for individuals with familiarity in areas such as equity and fixed-income markets, portfolio management, asset allocation, derivatives, valuation methods, financial modeling, risk management, behavioral finance, and macroeconomic influences on markets. A background in finance, economics, accounting, business, or a related field is preferred but not required. Experience in asset management, brokerage, research, financial planning, or related roles is valuable, and entry-level candidates with foundational knowledge of investments and strong analytical skills are encouraged to apply. Clear, metacognitive communication—explicitly articulating reasoning and decision processes (“showing your work”)—is essential. Ready to turn your knowledge of investments into the knowledge foundation for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and help train systems that support investors, analysts, and financial professionals worldwide. Role Overview We’re one team with one goal: delivering actual value. We share what we learn from customers, help our colleagues succeed, and focus on outcomes, not just checking boxes like 'completed call' or 'closed ticket.' Transactions at Koronet Transactions connects how our customers actually work with what our platform can do. We sit between customer feedback and product development, turning what we see in the field into real product improvements. We don't just 'do tasks'—we look for ways to solve problems and use what we learn to make the whole platform better for everyone. items.description: Back-End Programming Headquarters: Ghent - Belgium URL: https://www.twikey.com Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you. Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough. Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. You get plenty in return, such as the freedom and responsibility to deliver your own projects. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly. Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product. As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product. You focus on developing and improving the back-end of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions. With your expertise you'll make valuable suggestions and streamline processes for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results. You provide technical support on integration projects with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries. Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build. What are we looking for in you? You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work. Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn . You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks. You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning . You think along, question things and keep building new solutions. You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset. You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test. You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework . Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus. You have a deep understanding of databases. You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies. You have a very good command of English , for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset. You are based in a time zone within one hour of CET , so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration. You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central. Twikey offers you: An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first. The room to experiment, to challenge and to improve. And we expect you to really take that room. An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel! A complementary team of more than 35 colleagues who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere. A motivating workplace with plenty of knowledge and expertise , shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine. Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue. Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed! A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower. A salary package tailored to your experience and skills, with plenty of extra-legal benefits, a collective bonus system and a cafeteria plan to convert your 13th month as you choose. The chance to work in an innovative Belgian fintech scale-up that is active in several countries, in a sector that is growing fast! A job ad doesn't tell you everything. Our colleagues tell you here what it's really like to work at Twikey. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twikey-java-developer

items.summary: Headquarters: Palo Alto, CA, US; Remote, US About Pinterest: Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people be
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Palo Alto, CA, US; Remote, US About Pinterest: Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product. Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible. At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI. Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here . This role focuses on advancing the science and systems behind ML measurement, feature understanding, and causal inference at scale. The work spans areas such as production feature importance platforms, observational causal estimation in Pytorch, large-scale proxy metric development, and data-driven approaches to ML infrastructure efficiency. We're looking for an enthusiastic individual contributor to perform high-impact technical work across this space. This person will drive foundational innovations, own the end-to-end design of production ML systems, establish rigorous methodological standards, and partner cross-functionally to turn successful research into durable platform capabilities that raise the ceiling for the entire ML organization. What you’ll do: We are looking for an experienced and highly capable Data & Applied Scientist to help us drive step function improvements in our ML capabilities at Pinterest. In this role, you will: Translate research-grade DS workflows (e.g., proxy metrics, staleness models) into production ML pipelines using Airflow, WandB & Ray while establishing reusable patterns for other teams. Apply and productionize causal inference methods using the production ML stack (propensity scoring, IPW, TMLE) to address high-stakes measurement questions beyond experimental capabilities. Build self-serve tooling to empower non-experts to derive rigorous causal insights at scale. Partner with ML engineers and product teams to identify opportunities for improved tooling, metrics, and measurement methods, unlocking step-change improvements in model quality and business outcomes. Leverage Pinterest's rich metadata and engagement signals to build data-driven frameworks, from feature importance to content deindexing, that improve platform efficiency and speed. Design and build centralized ML platform tooling to improve feature and model creation, evaluation, and trust, including production systems that operate daily at scale across all models. What we’re looking for: 2+ years of hands-on experience as an applied scientist, ML engineer, research scientist or software engineer, with significant ML production experience. Strong Python skills; experience with PyTorch or equivalent deep learning frameworks; familiarity with distributed compute (Spark, Ray). Ray specifically is a strong plus. Enthusiasm for building tools and platforms that multiply the impact of an entire ML organization; not just solving one-off problems. Deep ML theory knowledge with extremely strong fundamentals that can help us reason about ML models from first principles. Proficiency in software development best practices including version control, code review, and reproducible ML pipelines. Experience with workflow management tools (Airflow, Prefect, Jenkins, or similar) for reliable ML pipeline orchestration. Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, or equivalent experience. Relocation Statement: This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model. In-Office Requirement Statement: We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role. This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 3-5 times/quarter and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country. #LI-NM4 #LI-REMOTE At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. Final salary is based on a number of factors including location, travel, relevant prior experience, or particular skills and expertise. Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here . US based applicants only $114,297 — $235,319 USD Our Commitment to Inclusion: Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you require a medical or religious accommodation during the job application process, please complete this form for support. By submitting this application, I certify that all information submitted in my application and throughout the hiring process is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that any false statement, omission, or misrepresentation may disqualify me from employment consideration or result in termination if discovered after hire. This role is ideal for someone who loves turning ideas into finished marketing campaigns. You'll write content, coordinate creative assets, keep projects moving, and make sure every email, social post, landing page, and product announcement is polished before it reaches our audience. We're not looking for flashy marketing copy. We're looking for someone who can communicate like a real human, who can write the way you'd talk to a designer over coffee: helpful, clear, and genuinely useful. If you're someone who notices the small details, enjoys keeping projects organized, and gets satisfaction from shipping great work, we'd love to hear from you. What you’ll help with: You'll work closely with our marketing and product teams to help bring campaigns to life by: Writing and editing marketing emails, newsletters, social posts, ads, landing pages, product updates, and promotional copy Turning campaign ideas, product launches, and feature updates into clear action plans, timelines, and deliverables Coordinating with designers to create graphics, creative assets, and revisions Gathering screenshots, product details, customer examples, links, and supporting materials needed for marketing projects Scheduling and publishing emails, social content, and other marketing updates Helping execute product launches, webinars, contests, promotions, and campaigns Reviewing marketing assets before they go live to ensure quality and accuracy Keeping marketing calendars, task lists, and project documentation organized and up to date Following up with team members to keep projects moving and deadlines on track What you’ll need: Excellent writing and editing skills Able to write marketing that feels like a helpful one-on-one conversation, not generic sales copy Strong understanding of audience, tone, and clear communication Exceptional organization and attention to detail (this is one of the most important parts of the role) Comfortable managing multiple projects at once without losing track of details Reliable follow-through and a bias toward getting things done Experience with email marketing, social media, content marketing, or campaign execution Bonus points: Experience working with SaaS companies Experience in the interior design industry or another creative field About us: DesignFiles is an all-in-one business platform built specifically for interior designers. Thousands of designers use DesignFiles to manage projects, collaborate with clients, create presentations, source products, and run more profitable businesses. Apply for the job: Love writing clear, helpful content and keeping marketing projects moving? Join DesignFiles as a remote Content Marketing Coordinator. items.description: About Remote Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote. With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role. We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform. If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work! The position This is an exciting time to join Remote and make a personal difference in the global employment space as a Senior Benefits Compliance Specialist , joining our Benefits team. As a Benefits Compliance Specialist, you will help establish Remote's benefits compliance function and ensure Remote’s benefits programs, operations, vendor processes, and product workflows remain compliant, scalable, and aligned with country-specific statutory and regulatory requirements. You will partner closely with Benefits Operations, Benefits Solutions, Legal, Payroll, Finance, Product, and external advisors to define standards, identify compliance risks, strengthen controls, and support reliable benefits delivery across Remote’s global footprint. What this job can offer you A role at the intersection of benefits operations, regulatory compliance, payroll, product, - helping Remote deliver compliant, scalable benefits globally and increase the value of our benefits product for customers. The ability to improve compliance controls and reduce operational risk across multiple countries and products. Exposure to complex global benefits topics, including statutory benefits, pensions, health insurance, vendor governance, and multi-product benefits delivery. The chance to contribute to scalable processes, automation, documentation, and reporting that improve compliance and increase the value of Remote’s benefits product for customers.. Key responsibilities Monitor and interpret benefits compliance requirements across countries where Remote operates, including statutory benefits, mandatory insurance, and supplemental benefits. Oversee compliance with statutory benefits filings, mandatory reporting, and regulatory obligations by partnering with stakeholders to ensure requirements are completed accurately and on time. Conduct regular audits of benefits processes, data, vendor outputs, payroll inputs, deductions, contributions, and operational workflows to identify compliance gaps or risks. Partner with Legal, Payroll, Finance, Benefits Operations, Benefits Solutions, Product, and external advisors to assess requirements and implement compliant processes. Identify areas of non-compliance or operational risk, document root causes, recommend remediation plans, and drive issues through to resolution. Design, implement, and maintain benefits compliance controls, SOPs, country guidance, escalation paths, and audit documentation. Translate regulatory and compliance requirements into operational and product requirements, ensuring new benefits launches and process changes are compliant by design. Track compliance incidents, remediation actions, and recurring risk themes; contribute to reporting and dashboards that improve visibility and accountability. Support vendor governance by helping review benefits provider processes, outputs, documentation, and compliance obligations. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that reduce manual work, improve data quality, and strengthen compliance outcomes. Stay up to date with global benefits legislation, regulatory updates, and best practices, and communicate relevant changes to stakeholders. What you bring Experience in benefits operations, benefits compliance, HR compliance, payroll compliance, legal operations, employment compliance, or a related field. Strong understanding of benefits administration and statutory benefits requirements, ideally across multiple countries or regions. Experience designing compliance frameworks and leading audits, reconciliations, risk assessments, controls, or compliance documentation. Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data, spreadsheets, reports, and operational evidence. Excellent attention to detail and ability to identify process gaps, inconsistencies, and compliance risks. Strong written communication skills, with the ability to turn complex requirements into clear documentation and guidance. Ability to manage multiple priorities across countries, stakeholders, and timelines. A proactive, ownership-oriented mindset with a bias toward scalable solutions and continuous improvement. Fast-forward to today, and we've transformed into Belkins Group — a vibrant ecosystem of services and products that define the cutting-edge landsc
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Macedonia / Georgia / Moldova / Romania / Greece / Croatia / Kosovo / Serbia URL: http://belkins.io In 2017, Belkins started as an appointment-setting agency with just one service offering. Fast-forward to today, and we've transformed into Belkins Group — a vibrant ecosystem of services and products that define the cutting-edge landscape of the SalesTech and MarTech industries. For seven years running, we’ve been the top appointment-setting agency, achieving amazing results across 50+ industries worldwide. Our results speak for themselves: with over 1,000 clients and a global portfolio, we’ve set up more than 200,000 appointments, delivering a $10 return for every $1 spent. We’re experts in B2B appointment setting, providing essential services for companies ready to take their growth to the next level. By diving deep into lead research and using customized, omnichannel strategies, we turn opportunities into real success. Joining Belkins means signing up for a journey of unstoppable growth and success, driven by curiosity, dedication, and a commitment to excellence. We are looking for a results-driven SDR to join our intake pod - the team that runs new clients through their first three months at Belkins. Each pod is built around an Account Strategist who owns client strategy through the pilot, supported by a Delivery Lead, Content Strategist, Researcher, and Email Deliverability Specialist. This structure means the technical side of outreach is handled for you - your focus is on calling and converting prospect responses into booked appointments. You will work across multiple pilot-stage client projects at once (typically 3-4), running high-volume cold calling via power dialer and personally managing all replies from automated email and LinkedIn campaigns. Because every account is brand new, the meetings you book in the first weeks carry extra weight - they're often a client's first real proof that the engagement is working. Things You’ll Be Doing: Cold Calling Running outbound calling campaigns via power dialer (Koncert) across multiple (3-4) pilot-stage client projects at once - every account brand-new, so there's no history to lean on and no slow ramp-up; Handling objections live, on the call, and steering each conversation toward a booked appointment, not just working through a script; Tracking connect rate and call-to-meeting conversion, flagging performance issues to your Account Strategist before they become a pattern - with only three months on the clock, a slow week can't go unnoticed. Reply Handling — Email & LinkedIn Personally owning every reply that comes in from automated email (Reply.io / Inbox AI) and LinkedIn (Expandi) campaigns -responding within 4–8 working hours, handling objections in writing, and nurturing prospects until they convert into confirmed meetings; Scheduling appointments and sharing meeting details with the team via Slack. Campaign Oversight & Reporting Monitoring key metrics across every project - connect rate, reply rate, conversion rate - as your own numbers, not someone else's dashboard. Feeding structured feedback to Research, Content, and EDS so lead quality and messaging actually improve, not just flagging that something isn't working. Keeping CRM hygiene tight in HubSpot and sharing a weekly recap your Account Strategist can actually use. What You Bring: 2+ years of outbound SDR experience with a strong cold calling background ; Fluent English - written and spoken - comfortable working across US and European time zones; Metrics-driven: you track your dials, connect rates, and conversion numbers and know how to improve them; Strong objection handling and a consistent track record of landing next steps; Comfortable working brand-new accounts with no track record yet, and able to manage multiple pilot-stage client projects in parallel without losing quality or pace; Reliable CRM hygiene and disciplined follow-up across all open threads; Self-starting and proactive - you hold your pace without needing external pressure. How We Hire: Recruiter Interview (~30 minutes) — with Yuliia or Inna. Practical Task (~60–90 minutes) — a written exercise covering outbound thinking, objection handling, and lead prioritization. Hiring Manager Interview (~45–60 minutes) — a conversation with the SDR Enablement Manager covering the details of your work, performance analytics, and a live cold-call roleplay. Final Interview (~60 minutes) — with the Managing Director and HR Business Partner to assess company fit and explore your values and working style. Offer & Onboarding — if it's a yes, we move fast. *We may use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process. Final decisions are made by humans. Contact us for information on data processing. At Belkins, we care deeply about our team members, and we prove it through: Competitive Pay: Your dedication deserves more than recognition; it deserves compensation that matches your expertise. Remote-First Flexibility: We’ve transitioned to a fully remote environment so you can work where you're most productive. Our flexible hours help you stay agile and focused. Professional Growth: We’re a launchpad for your career. Through regular feedback, 1:1s, internal mobility, and knowledge-sharing, your growth is enabled and celebrated. We also maintain an internal wiki for insights and a library of the latest business books to keep you sharp. Well-being focus: Your mental health is a priority. We offer mental health lectures and support for your overall well-being. Recharge Time: We prioritize your rest with 20 paid vacation days, parental leave, fully covered sick days, and unlimited days off for unexpected needs. Global Sync: We align with U.S. holidays to keep our global teams in sync. Memorable Team Experiences: Work hard, play hard — even from a distance. Our online team-building events and all-hands gatherings bring humor, memes, and a lively atmosphere that makes teamwork genuinely fun. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/belkins-sales-development-representative-intake-pod

Demonstrated understanding of data structures, analytics, and solution architecture (conceptual fluency required; hands-on engineering not required). Proven ability to coordinate, organize, lead, and develop teams, and to manage competing priorities across many stakeholders. Comfort working on technical projects and with oil & gas business applications, with a strong understanding of how the business works. Strong executive communication and stakeholder-management skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience developing or leading Salesforce-based business processes and custom solutions. Experience with data tools, pipelines, and analytics platforms (e.g., Power BI, Databricks). Engineering and/or operational experience in the oil & gas industry (beneficial, not required). Experience leading a portfolio, delivery, or business-process function. Familiarity with EQT’s “Way We Work” operating model (Programs, Utilities, Insights, Sessions, and Knowledge). Selected incumbent will be placed into the position that best suits their abilities and experience level. EQT Corporation and its subsidiaries is an Equal Opportunity Employer -- Disabilities/Veterans. Originally posted on Himalayas

Atuamos em diversos mercados, como serviços financeiros, saúde, automotivo, agronegócio, seguros, entre outros. A Experian investe em pessoas e em novas tecnologias avançadas para liberar o poder dos dados. Contamos com uma equipe incrível de 25.200 colaboradores em 32 países. Nossa singularidade é valorizar a sua. A cultura da Experian, centrada nas pessoas, inclusiva e orientada por propósito, é reconhecida por diversos prêmios - incluindo World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Top 25 global da Fortune) e Great Place To Work™ em 26 países, entre outros. Confira o Experian Life nas redes sociais ou explore nosso site de carreiras para entender o porquê. A Experian também se orgulha de ser uma empregadora que promove igualdade de oportunidades e ação afirmativa. Description Product Owner - Finance Systems & Projects Sobre a posição Buscamos um(a) Product Owner para atuar como elo entre as áreas de Finanças e Tecnologia, garantindo a estabilidade, evolução e melhoria contínua dos sistemas financeiros da organização. Este profissional será responsável por liderar a gestão de demandas, incidentes e melhorias sistêmicas, assegurando rápida resposta às necessidades do negócio, além de atuar na condução de projetos estratégicos de transformação e automação de processos financeiros. A posição exige forte interação com stakeholders de diversas áreas de finanças, capacidade de priorização em ambientes dinâmicos e habilidade para traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções tecnológicas eficientes. Principais Responsabilidades Sustentação de Sistemas Financeiros Atuar como responsável funcional pelos sistemas de finanças, garantindo sua operação contínua e aderência às necessidades do negócio. Gerenciar e priorizar demandas, incidentes e problemas críticos, assegurando tratamento adequado dentro dos SLAs definidos. Conduzir análises de causa raiz e coordenar planos de ação para mitigação de recorrências. Atuar como principal ponto de contato entre as áreas de negócio e as equipes de TI para temas relacionados à sustentação. Avaliar impactos de mudanças sistêmicas nos processos financeiros e operacionais. Realizar acompanhamento contínuo da saúde dos sistemas, identificando riscos e oportunidades de melhoria. Gestão de Relacionamento com o Negócio Manter relacionamento próximo e constante com as áreas de Finanças. Conduzir reuniões recorrentes de alinhamento, priorização e acompanhamento das demandas. Levantar requisitos, mapear processos e traduzir necessidades de negócio para equipes técnicas. Garantir comunicação clara e permanente entre stakeholders, usuários-chave e times de tecnologia. Gestão de Projetos Liderar projetos de evolução sistêmica, automação e transformação digital para as áreas financeiras. Coordenar atividades desde a definição do escopo até implantação em produção. Elaborar cronogramas, planos de ação, análise de riscos e acompanhamento de entregas. Conduzir cerimônias de projeto e reuniões executivas de status. Apoiar processos de testes, homologação, treinamento e gestão da mudança. Gestão de Backlog e Priorização Manter backlog de melhorias e demandas atualizado e priorizado. Definir critérios de priorização considerando impacto financeiro, riscos regulatórios, experiência do usuário e valor para o negócio. Trabalhar junto às equipes de desenvolvimento para refinamento de requisitos e acompanhamento das entregas. Qualifications Conhecimento dos principais processos financeiros, incluindo: Contratação e Faturamento (Billing) Contas a Receber (Accounts Receivable) Revenue Recognition Cobrança e aplicações de recebimentos Controles financeiros e contábeis Inglês avançado obrigatório Sistemas e Ferramentas Gestão de backlog (Jira, Azure DevOps ou similares) Ferramentas de documentação (Confluence ou similares) Power BI e IA (desejável) Experiência com ERP, sistemas financeiros e integrações Metodologias Agile / Scrum Kanban Gestão de Projetos Competências Comportamentais Comunicação clara e objetiva Forte capacidade de priorização Senso de urgência Organização e gestão simultânea de múltiplas demandas Perfil colaborativo e orientado ao cliente interno Capacidade de negociação com stakeholders Visão de processos e resolução de problemas Facilidade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e com constante mudança de prioridades Diferenciais Experiência prévia em áreas de Finance Systems, Finance Transformation ou Product Ownership em Finanças. Conhecimento de processos O2C, P2P e R2R. Experiência em sustentação de aplicações corporativas críticas. Participação em projetos de implementação ou transformação de sistemas financeiros. Additional Information Esta é uma posição exclusiva para pessoas com deficiência (PcD). Como parte do nosso compromisso com a inclusão e a igualdade de oportunidades, aqui na Serasa temos diversas iniciativas, como por exemplo: intérpretes de libras, tecnologias assistivas, cordão girassol (deficiências ocultas), entre outras ações. Na Serasa Experian temos o grupo Aspire que visa construir para um ambiente acessível e de oportunidades justas para os profissionais com deficiência. Venha fazer parte dessa transformação! Caso você não se identifique com este grupo, convidamos você a explorar outras oportunidades em nossa página de carreiras. Temos diversas vagas que podem se conectar com seu perfil e interesses. #LI-HOME Experian Careers - Creating a better tomorrow together Find out what its like to work for Experian by clicking here

items.title: Conceptual Art Director
items.summary: Superside is looking for a talented Conceptual Art Director with a passion for Generative AI to create bold, high-performing digital campaigns for top global brands. In this role, you’ll partner with copywriters, strategists and creatives to deliver concept-driven ideas across social media, web, video, and more—bringing big ideas to life with strong art direction and design execution. You’ll thrive in a collaborative, globally distributed team and contribute to work that’s not only creatively exciting but also strategically sharp. This is a role for someone who can think big, execute beautifully, and bring a deep understanding of design to everything they do.

items.title: Conceptual Copywriter
items.summary: Superside is looking for a talented Conceptual Copywriter to ideate and execute impactful creative work across digital campaigns and marketing channels. In this role, you’ll partner with designers, strategists, and performance teams to develop concept-driven copy that delivers both creative impact and measurable results. You will work closely with enterprise-level customers helping translate complex technical ideas into clear, compelling messaging for global audiences. This role is ideal for a writer who enjoys turning strategic insights into powerful creative ideas while crafting high-performing copy across digital platforms.

items.title: Lead Creative Strategist (Performance Marketing)
items.summary: Superside is hiring a Creative Strategist, Performance Marketing to lead the strategic thinking behind our clients' highest-volume, highest-velocity creative programs. You'll sit at the intersection of data and creative, turning performance signals from paid social, OOH, and programmatic campaigns into sharp, testable creative direction — while acting as a trusted strategic partner to the clients whose business results depend on it. You'll run strategy across a portfolio of accounts at once, each producing a high volume of creative every month, and you'll be the person both the client and the creative team turn to when they need to know not just what to make next, but why.

items.summary: Position Type : Full-time Location: Philippines (Remote) Schedule: Mon-Fri, EST About the Company Our client is a global leader in swimming pool technology, specializing in robotic pool cleaners, pool safety products, water treatment solutions, and related pool equipment for residential and commercial customers. With a strong international presence and a network of distributors, subsidiaries, and partners across multiple markets, our client serves customers worldwide through a variety of sales and distribution channels. About the Role Our client is looking for a Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst to monitor online marketplaces and digital channels across North America and Europe. The role focuses on identifying unauthorized sellers, marketplace and distribution violations, misuse of brand assets, and other compliance issues. You will conduct online research, analyze seller and product data, maintain accurate records, and prepare reports that provide actionable insights to the business. Responsibilities Monitor Amazon, eBay, Walmart, BestBuy, Home Depot, AliExpress, Temu, and other major marketplaces. Research products and identify new or unauthorized sellers. Classify sellers and verify their authorization status. Identify MAP, distribution, territory, and marketplace compliance issues. Monitor unauthorized use of logos, images, trademarks, and product content. Collect evidence such as URLs, screenshots, seller information, and product details. Maintain accurate seller databases and internal records. Prepare daily reports and monthly Voice of Consumer reports. Build and maintain dashboards tracking brand-protection metrics. Identify opportunities to improve research and reporting processes. Competencies and Qualifications Must-Have 3+ years of experience in data analysis, online research, e-commerce, compliance, or a related field. Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables. Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy. Strong written English and reporting skills. Ability to work independently and follow SOPs. Familiarity with Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces. Nice-to-Have Brand protection or marketplace compliance experience. Experience with PROWL, Helium 10, Salesforce, or similar tools. Knowledge of MAP, distribution, or channel compliance. Experience with dashboards and reporting. Experience using AI research and translation tools. items.description: At Instructure , we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers. We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in: HR Shared Services is the front door for employee questions at Instructure. Our team handles day-to-day questions and owns complex cases: escalations, compliance-sensitive issues, and the problems that don't have a template answer yet. What you'll do. Manage and coach a team of HR specialists, including performance, development, and day-to-day workload. Own escalations and complex employee cases end to end, from intake through resolution, keeping quality and consistency high. Take ownership of AskHR reporting and dashboards, turning ticket and case data into insights HR leadership can act on. Monitor knowledge base quality and close gaps so employees can self-serve more and escalate less. Drive process improvement, especially where automation can take on more of the routine volume. Some of the specific processes you’ll own include: immigration, global compliance, background checks and reporting Cross-functional partnership with Payroll, IT and other HR COEs. What you'll bring. Three to five years of HR experience, ideally in a shared services, HR operations, or people support environment. One to two years leading a team Comfort with case management and ticketing tools (we use Jira and Confluence); dashboard or reporting experience is a strong plus. Sound judgment on sensitive or ambiguous cases, and the ability to know when something needs to be escalated further. Experience with Workday or a similar HRIS. Exposure to global or multi-region HR support Get in on all the awesome at Instructure! We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect: Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success. Flexible work culture. Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location. Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs. Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth The technology and tools you need to do your best work Motivosity employee recognition program A culture rooted in inclusivity, support, and meaningful connection We believe in hiring great people and treating them right. The more diverse we are, the better our ideas and outcomes. Instructure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with applicable employment and anti-discrimination laws in every country where we operate. All employees must pass a background check as part of the hiring process. To help protect our teams and systems, we’ve implemented identity verification measures. Candidates may be asked to verify their legal name, current physical location, and provide a valid contact number and residential address, in accordance with local data privacy laws. Any attempt to misrepresent personal or professional information will result in disqualification.

items.description: The Opportunity: Data privacy has become one of the most strategic challenges facing modern enterprises — sitting at the intersection of AI governance, data operations, and customer trust. As companies adopt AI at scale, they need new ways to automate privacy and manage risk without slowing innovation. DataGrail has launched the first agentic privacy platform, and we're entering a pivotal phase of growth as we scale toward the next stage of the business. DataGrail is shipping innovative products faster than ever before to meet our customers' needs and outpace the competition. As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you’ll build the launch and enablement engine that turns that product velocity into customer adoption and revenue. You’ll ensure every release reaches the right audience, equip our GTM teams to confidently communicate the value of new capabilities, and help customers understand how the DataGrail platform solves their most important privacy challenges. This is a foundational, high-impact role. The systems, enablement programs, and AI-powered workflows you build during your first six months will shape how DataGrail brings new capabilities to market, helping accelerate adoption, support revenue growth and set the business up for long-term success. What You'll Do Design and own a continuous launch program that scales with our release process Deliver field enablement that instills confidence and empowers customer-facing teams to effectively position new capabilities and win deals Own competitive and voice-of-customer intelligence, turning it into messaging, battlecards, and playbooks that convert our target buyer Use AI to build a repeatable product content workflow, producing consistent, high-performing product content across formats and channels Take full, end-to-end ownership of Tier 1 launches, including strategy, cross-functional coordination, execution, and measurement Partner across Growth, Product, Sales, and CS to build consensus and drive shared outcomes. What You'll Bring 3–5 years of product marketing experience in B2B SaaS A track record of building (not just running) launch programs from scratch Strong positioning and product content instincts, ability to produce high-performing product content across formats and channels Expertise in using AI tools to build innovative, efficient solutions to complex challenges Strong project management skills, you’ve run multi-stage, multi-stakeholder initiatives with true ownership An understanding of what Sales and Customer Success teams need to effectively position, sell, and support new products Technical aptitude to understand complex concepts and translate them to compelling stories Bonus Points Experience in privacy, security, or another trust-driven B2B category with complex competitive dynamics Experience owning competitive intelligence programs that directly informed product roadmap decisions A history of building AI-driven workflows that improve how teams work, not just your own personal productivity What Success Looks Like Within 90 Days You'll: Adopt the existing launch tiering framework Become an SME on our story, positioning, ICP, and personas Identify gaps in current systems for a continuous-shipping world Build a roadmap to refine tiering and launch process to match shipping pace Establish release tracking with the product team Within 180 Days You'll: Build an AI framework for structure and speed at continuous-shipping pace Stand up a repeatable process for collateral and field-facing docs Run point on all tier 2 and tier 3 launches Launch and adoption KPI dashboards live Establish a field feedback loop with GTM teams Within 365 Days You'll: Full launch and enablement system live, powered by the AI framework At least one tier 1 launch owned end-to-end Recognized as a key partner to product and GTM teams Messaging framework refined based on customer feedback, new products, and market shifts Please note that the base compensation range below is a guideline and the final compensation will be based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, and competencies. Our compensation ranges apply to all US-based job postings regardless of state. All full-time regular employees are eligible for equity, health, dental & vision insurance plans, remote-first working environment, 401k savings plan, parental leave, wellness benefits, flexible time off, paid holidays, and a work from home stipend. Benefits are subject to change. Compensation Range $150,000—$170,000 USD About Us: DataGrail is the Agentic Data Privacy Platform. We help the world’s leading brands such as HubSpot, FanDuel, Dexcom, Major League Soccer, and Okta automate privacy and control risk with secure, human-governed AI that scales. Powered by Vera, the complete privacy AI agent, and underpinned by an unrivaled 2,500+ integrations and no-compromise security architecture, DataGrail is built to solve complex privacy challenges that others can't. DataGrail is rated 4.8/5 stars on G2 and is a two-time recognized privacy leader by IDC. DataGrail provides equal opportunities for everyone that works for us and everyone that applies to join our team, without regard to sex or gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, pregnancy, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, any service, past, present, or future, in the uniformed services of the United States (military or veteran status), or any other consideration protected by federal, state, or local law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses. We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every…
items.description: Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization .We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey. We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses. We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey. We're designing the future of autonomous marketing , taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do. And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora. Bloomreach builds agentic AI systems for our customers. We also run them ourselves. Our AI SDR program books sales meetings with AI - inbound and outbound, across four regions, in multiple languages. The program needs an owner: someone who sets its direction, drives its results, and proves its ROI. This is a program leadership role, not an engineering one. Two dedicated AI ops experts build and run the platform. You decide what it does, why, and for whom. You should understand AI agents well enough to direct the people building them - your leverage is judgment, but being tech savvy is a must. The team experiments by default: we test new AI tools, run scoped POCs, and keep what works. You'll own the program, its direction, its results, its pipeline number. What you'll own The AI SDR program, end to end. Inbound and outbound, AMER + EMEA + APAC. Who gets enrolled, what the agents say, when a human takes over, and what it produces in pipeline. You set direction; the platform ops managers make it run. (Inbound request ops and routing sit with a colleague.) Pipeline as your number, ROI as your story. Meetings booked → accepted → qualified pipeline created. Cost per meeting, cost per pipeline dollar. You report the program's return to leadership, with numbers that hold up under questioning. The human SDR side. SDRs are the other half of the program - and where it most often breaks: lead quality disputes, unclear prioritization, follow-up that dies after one touch, handovers that lose context. You'll sit with the SDR teams and their leaders, find root causes, and fix them - with an AI assist, a process change, or a better definition. The human–agent split. What agents do, what humans do, and where the handover sits. You own that line and move it based on evidence. Signal-driven enrollment. Targeting runs on manual batches today. You'll drive the move to continuous enrollment based on account scoring, intent signals, and engagement decay. You define the logic; the ops team builds it. The buying experience. Outreach should arrive because an account signalled something, say something true about the buyer's business, and make the next step obvious. Program reporting. Volume, coverage, results, and ROI on a live dashboard, generated automatically. Parts still run on exports. Fix that early. What comes next. The AI SDR pattern - signal in, agent acts, human closes - applies beyond outbound: event follow-up, hand-raiser nurture, re-engagement. Once the core program runs well, you'll make the case for the next one and drive its launch. What success looks like after 3 months Outbound volume and coverage are consistent across regions. Nobody asks "why did outbound drop last week?" Leadership references your ROI model in planning: cost per meeting, cost per pipeline dollar, trend. The top three SDR pain points from your first quarter are root-caused and fixed - and SDR leaders would confirm it unprompted. Meeting acceptance is high. Rejections have known causes, not theories. Reporting is fully automated. Your time goes into decisions. The program activities and volume is connected to human activities, pipeline number for ICP accounts is bigger - and you can show which changes drove it. At least one new agentic program is live and producing pipeline. What you'll bring You've run programs with a number attached. Demand gen, SDR/BDR, growth, or GTM programs where you owned the outcome and defended the metric. You've operated AI workflows in production. You've deployed, directed, or owned automations other people depended on. You can set requirements, challenge the build, and tell when the agent is the problem versus the data. You don't need to write code - you do need to never be bluffed by it. ROI fluency. You can build a cost-per-outcome model and explain it. You'd rather show a live dashboard than a slide. You diagnose team problems at the source. "The leads are bad" is where your investigation starts, not where it ends. You've worked with frontline teams, found the real constraint, and fixed it. SDRs, AEs, and their leaders are your users. When the program misfires, you’ll be their point of contact. The buyer's point of view. Buyers don't care that outreach was efficient - only that it was worth their time. You'll kill a volume that doesn't clear that bar. Enough technical depth to be dangerous. You can read a workflow, question a data model, and learn a new tool in a week. Experience with our stack is welcome, not required. Global comfort. Four regions, several languages, overlap with US hours. Big Advantage:: hands-on LLM tooling beyond vendor UIs (Claude Code, MCP, custom agents); time in or working with SDR/BDR and demand gen function in B2B SaaS. The stack you'll drive Salesforce · Qualified · Salesloft · UserGems · Claude - plus a mandate to evaluate AI-native tooling with a clear bar for measurable impact. The team You'll join Marketing Operations six people who operationalize and automate everything in marketing. Two of them work full-time on the AI SDR platform: they build and run it; you set its direction and co-own it: reporting and attribution, co-own and maintain inbound/outbound processes and find new tools. It's a team that builds its own tools rather than filing tickets for them. More things you'll like about Bloomreach: Culture: A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one. We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication. We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style. We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents. We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead. We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*. The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5 Personal Development: We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions. Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.* Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins. Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)* Well-being: The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.* Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.* We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones. We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other. Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.* Compensation: Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.* Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.* We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000! We reward & celebrate work anniversaries -- Bloomversaries!* (*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.) Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences! If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it - we will be very grateful! Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of Bloomreach are considered property of Bloomreach and are not subject to payment of agency fees. #LI-Remote

items.title: Business Operations Manager
items.summary: About MonetizeMoreMonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally.
items.description: About MonetizeMore MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture-first organization driven by four core values: Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen (Continuous Improvement), and Collaboration . We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on. About the Role The company is seeking an experienced, systems-driven Business Operations Manager to transform informal workflows into owned, structured, and scalable operational systems. As the primary connective layer across departments, this role focuses on process kaizen, SOP governance, and end-to-end operational enablement—ensuring teams execute efficiently without reinventing processes. The Business Operations Manager will manage the central project management infrastructure and partner directly with Product and executive leadership. Key responsibilities include preparing cross-functional teams for product launches, streamlining enterprise client workflows, and establishing organization-wide standards for accountability and visibility. As a data- and AI-fluent operator, the candidate will design structured spreadsheet models, integrate AI tools to accelerate documentation, and continuously optimize reporting systems. Core Responsibilities 1. Process Kaizen & SOP Governance Run a continuous improvement cadence across the process landscape; killing, combining, or improving SOPs weekly. Own the process vault and ensure every process is signed off by its owner and governed for adoption, not just documented. 2. Project Management & Visibility Own and maintain BE's project management tracker; ensuring all projects, to-dos, and tickets are tracked, visible, and actioned. Drive adoption beyond BE, building the foundation for a company-wide model with long-term integration into BL L10s. 3. Product Rollout Support Support product release processes, structuring the operational side of launches so teams are enabled ahead of go-live. Work closely with the incoming Group PM to formalize this process as a repeatable model. 4. Cross-Departmental & Enterprise Client Enablement Act as an operational connective layer across business lines and enterprise client workflows; surfacing blockers, coordinating data and documentation needs, and keeping cross-functional commitments visible and actioned. 5. Data & Spreadsheet Management Own data pulls and spreadsheet-based reporting for BE initiatives; Building and maintaining structured, reliable models that others can use without re-deriving logic. Comfort with formulas, structured data, and dashboard hygiene is core to the role, not incidental. Who You Are The Experienced Operator: You have 4+ years of experience in a process, project management, or business operations role. Ad tech, SaaS, high-data-volume or WordPress ecosystem experience is a plus, as is experience working with Salesforce (SFDC). The Systems Builder: You default to structure, and you know the difference between owning a process and doing the work inside it. Given a messy or untracked workstream, your instinct is to define ownership, standardize steps, and build the scaffolding (trackers, SOPs, cadences) that lets other functions execute reliably. Data- and AI-Fluent: You're comfortable pulling, cleaning, and structuring data in spreadsheets without hand-holding, and you've used AI tools in your actual workflow to speed up documentation and process work. Comfortable with Ambiguity: You can walk into an undefined workstream, ask the right questions, and leave it with clear ownership and a repeatable process. Direct Communicator: You flag problems early and plainly. You don't let a stalled ticket or an unsigned SOP sit quietly. What We Offer True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with an flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle. Professional Development: Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Senior PPC Specialist
items.summary: We're looking for a Senior PPC Specialist to lead paid acquisition efforts across Meta, Google, and other digital advertising platforms.
items.description: We're looking for a Senior PPC Specialist to lead paid acquisition efforts across Meta, Google, and other digital advertising platforms. This is a hands-on role for someone who understands that successful paid media isn't just about launching campaigns; it's about maximizing profitability. You'll be responsible for optimizing the entire acquisition funnel, analyzing campaign performance, improving conversion rates, and making strategic decisions that drive sustainable growth. The ideal candidate is analytical, data-driven, and comfortable balancing campaign execution with performance strategy. Requirements Key Responsibilities Plan, launch, and optimize paid media campaigns across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and other advertising platforms. Monitor and improve key performance metrics, including ROAS, CPA, CAC, CTR, Conversion Rate, and LTV. Identify profitability issues and optimize the entire conversion funnel. Conduct A/B testing for audiences, creatives, landing pages, and offers. Analyze campaign performance and provide actionable insights through dashboards and reports. Manage advertising budgets and scale high-performing campaigns. Collaborate with creative and marketing teams to improve campaign results. Implement and maintain tracking using GA4, Google Tag Manager, and advertising platforms. Stay up to date with industry trends, AI tools, and platform updates. Requirements Resume in English. Native or near-native English proficiency (spoken and written). 4+ years of experience managing Meta and Google Ads campaigns. Proven experience optimizing campaigns based on ROAS, CPA, CAC, and profitability. Strong understanding of conversion funnels and conversion rate optimization (CRO). Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and reporting dashboards. Experience managing six-figure monthly advertising budgets is a plus. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience with eCommerce, SaaS, Lead Generation, or Performance Marketing campaigns. Ability to translate data into actionable optimization strategies.
