items.title: Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!
items.description: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process! About the role The CFO’s mission is to continue building upon Grüns ' already strong finance and data function — evolving it into a best-in-class engine that empowers the entire organization to make faster, smarter decisions. Leading a team of three strong leaders, this role is about leading the strong teams below them to democratize financial intelligence across the Grüns organization: self-serve dashboards, on-demand reporting, and real-time visibility that puts decision-making power in the hands of every team member. The CFO is a relentless, collaborative business partner, never satisfied with where the business is on revenue scale or profitability, always pushing for the next point of EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and driving efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. They will ensure Grüns scales with confidence while meeting all external requirements seamlessly in the background. This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL. What success looks like: If we look ahead a year from now, the right person in this role would have: Leveraged what we’ve built so far, found areas for improvement, and fully operationalized a goal accountability framework that keeps business initiatives tied to financial outcomes, ensuring the leadership team is consistently tracking toward revenue and profitability targets. Driven meaningful EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and improved LTV:CAC efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. Delivered self-serve dashboards, templatized reporting, and real-time P&L visibility across functions so every team has the data access they need without relying on ad-hoc requests. Business decisions are democratized and exponentially quicker. Created the conditions for a high-performing, motivated team empowering vs. micromanaging, actively developing leaders, and driving strong results and performance without burnout. Built the systems and processes to meet all external reporting and compliance requirements seamlessly, keeping the team focused on growth. We're looking for someone with: Relentless Growth Mindset: Always asking what it takes to get to the next level, whether that's another point of margin, better efficiency, or a faster path to revenue growth - a genuine internal drive to make the business the best it can be. Finding new opportunities across the business and proposing these opportunities to the CEO and functional leads. Integrity and Business-First Thinking: Prioritizes the truth over “looking good”. Navigates competing stakeholder interests honestly and thoroughly rather than taking the path of least resistance. Empowering Leadership: Leads by giving people the tools, clarity, and confidence to make great decisions vs. controlling the work directly. Actively develops their functional leaders, makes their team better than they were before. Drives sustainable high performance. Paper Wall Pusher: Treats perceived constraints as hypotheses, not facts. When told something takes six weeks or "this is how it's done," they ask why and push for faster, smarter, or different. Actively hunts for process bloat and inherited ways of working to find improvements. AI-Native Operator: Uses AI natively in their own workflow and actively builds AI fluency into the team's operating model. Sees AI as a core lever for scaling the function's impact without scaling headcount. Direct, but kind: Direct and honest in every conversation, saying what needs to be said, even when it's uncomfortable. Deeply committed to the business and the people in it. Experience: 10+ years leadership experience in a high-growth, profitable businesses; some level of physical inventory experience (CPG, retail, e-commerce, or similar) is a must Experience leading the functions in scope - finance, accounting, data, and BizOps functions Experience within a high-growth company that is adapting to public company practices Compensation & Benefits: At Grüns , we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary is $350,000 + incentive compensation, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team. A bit about us... At Grüns , we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you. Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all. So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious. What we care about... Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation. Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners. Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most. Compensation & Perks: For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth. Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns subscriptions, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about! Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Liquidity Operations Analyst
items.summary: Work with the bestWe are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms.
items.description: Work with the best We are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms. We are not satisfied with the limitations of centralized exchanges or the complexities of building decentralized order books. We aim to make trading easy, fast, and secure for everyone. How? By fusing the simplicity of CeFi with the power of DeFi. At the heart of the issue lies “liquidity”. Builders often grapple with a paradox; traders need liquidity, but liquidity demands traders. Our solution is simple as is bold –concentrate all liquidity into one order book. One order book that connects all the liquidity in the crypto space. Our ambition doesn't stop there. We're omnichain, championing chain abstraction. We envision seamless transactions, where the underlying blockchain is merely a detail. By concentrating liquidity, we aim to redefine the crypto landscape, making bridging and wrapped assets a thing of the past. We are Orderly, and we are here to revolutionize DeFi, democratizing access to financial opportunities and fostering a fair, equitable paradigm for all. A Glimpse into Your Future at Orderly Network What will you be working on? Process, clean, and validate liquidity and trading data to ensure accuracy and usability. Extract and transform trading data to generate regular reports (weekly/monthly) and support alerting mechanisms. Monitor liquidity dashboards and identify anomalies in a timely manner. Maintain and update market parameter configuration tables. Support market maker onboarding and assist with incentive distribution processes. Participate in data analysis for liquidity mechanism design and assist in testing new incentive models. Who will you be working with? Work closely with the liquidity operations team on daily monitoring and execution. Collaborate with product, trading, and data teams to ensure data accuracy and operational efficiency. Support coordination with market makers during onboarding and ongoing operations. What challenges will you face? Handling large volumes of trading data with high accuracy requirements. Identifying anomalies and ensuring data quality in a fast-moving trading environment. Balancing data processing, monitoring, and operational support tasks simultaneously. Adapting quickly to evolving liquidity strategies and incentive mechanisms. Interested in Learning More? Our hiring process begins by meeting with our People Team, who help facilitate the process of placing you in your new role. You can expect to share your experience and ideas in online video interviews with our hiring team, made up of management and potential new colleagues. If you have experience in developing trading systems or financial-related products is a plus. You can prepare for this interview by mentally organizing your strategies and opinions on topics such as Web3, cryptocurrency trading platforms, and your vision of how to succeed. Share this! Don’t be afraid of friends or co-workers stealing this job! If you are amazing and smart we will find a place for you. Check out our External Referral Incentives Program as well. Originally posted on Himalayas

The team identifies and develops client connections, engages client representatives to obtain KYC documentation, and acts as a coordination point for resolving issues/challenges with respect to client and country specific documentation requirements in a timely manner. In addition to the ongoing document engagement, individuals within the team keep abreast of global regulatory change that could influence processes, and identify opportunities that enhance the client experience. The Role The KYC Client Outreach Change team oversee delivery of Front Line Unit (FLU) programs, process engineering, and tools and systems used by the FLU. items.description: Company Description Are you ready to join the forefront of technology innovation with Netcompany? As one of the fastest growing technology companies, we are disrupting the marketplace and revolutionizing the way businesses operate. Our vision is to be the leading digital challenger in Europe whilst evolving the next generation of IT consulting. Operating across both public and private sectors, we offer a comprehensive range of services from application development and seamless cloud migration to program delivery and service operations, our offerings are designed to meet diverse business needs. Job Description Netcompany is looking for a Senior Agile Delivery Manager to drive forward our delivery capability and deliver the optimum solutions to the clients. As a Delivery Manager, in our Application Development unit, you will be working on a variety of projects. Based in London or Leeds, this is a great opportunity to join one of the most exciting, innovative, prestigious and forward-thinking technology-enabled organisations in the UK. Key responsibilities: Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex digital services, ensuring agreed outcomes are achieved within scope, budget, timescales and quality expectations. Provide hands-on agile delivery leadership across one or more multidisciplinary teams, adapting ways of working to the delivery context and undertaking Scrum Master responsibilities where appropriate, including facilitating planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives and backlog refinement. Create the conditions for effective agile delivery by removing blockers, managing dependencies and helping teams continuously improve how they work. Work closely with Product Managers to translate product strategy and priorities into achievable delivery plans, balancing user needs, business objectives and technical constraints. Lead multidisciplinary teams comprising delivery, product, engineering, architecture, quality assurance, business analysis, data and user-centred design professionals, building team capability and supporting individuals to grow and perform effectively. Ensure user-centred design disciplines, including user research, service design, interaction design and content design, are integrated throughout delivery. Support services through the GDS delivery lifecycle, from Discovery and Alpha through Beta and Live, ensuring alignment with the Government Service Standard and Technology Code of Practice. Plan and coordinate GDS service assessments, including assessment readiness, evidence gathering, team preparation and the management of recommendations arising from assessments. Maintain effective delivery controls, including delivery plans, RAID logs, dependency management, resource forecasting, governance reporting and stakeholder communications. Take a hands-on approach to Jira and Confluence, ensuring backlogs, workflows, dashboards, documentation, decisions and delivery reporting are accurate and actively maintained. Manage delivery across complex technology environments involving system integration, legacy platforms, cloud services and third-party suppliers. Provide clear and transparent reporting on delivery progress, risks, dependencies, finances and outcomes to senior management, clients and governance forums. Build trusted relationships with clients, stakeholders, suppliers and team members, constructively challenging decisions where required to protect delivery outcomes. Contribute to the wider delivery management community through knowledge sharing, coaching and mentoring less experienced colleagues. Qualifications Extensive experience of leading complex digital or technology delivery within government or the wider public sector. Strong practical knowledge of agile delivery methods, alongside experience of traditional and hybrid delivery approaches, with the ability to select and adapt the most appropriate with experience performing both Delivery Manager and Scrum Master responsibilities. Demonstrable experience of leading multidisciplinary digital teams that include Product Management, engineering, quality assurance, business analysis and user-centred design professionals. Strong understanding of the respective accountabilities of Delivery Managers and Product Managers, with evidence of effective collaboration to manage priorities, roadmaps and delivery outcomes. Practical experience of working through the GDS delivery lifecycle and applying the Government Service Standard. Experience of preparing teams and services for GDS service assessments, responding to assessor feedback and implementing recommendations. Advanced, hands-on experience of Jira and Confluence or other project management tools including backlog management, workflows, dashboards, reporting and delivery documentation. Strong knowledge of the software delivery lifecycle, including Discovery, Alpha, Beta, Live and ongoing service improvement. Experience of delivery planning, dependency management, risk and issue management, resource forecasting and governance reporting. Experience of managing system integration initiatives involving multiple technologies, delivery teams and third-party suppliers. Proven ability to remove delivery blockers, manage competing priorities and create an environment in which teams can deliver effectively. Excellent facilitation, coaching and servant-leadership skills, with the ability to embed agile behaviours and drive continuous improvement. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to build trust, communicate complex delivery matters clearly and constructively challenge senior stakeholders. Experience of contributing to a professional community through knowledge sharing, coaching and mentoring. A recognised agile delivery or Scrum Master qualification, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience. Willingness to work within a hybrid model and travel occasionally to client or delivery locations. Additional Information Benefits include Hybrid working model with some flexible working 25 days’ holiday Private Medical Health care via Vitality Pension contribution, Life Assurance Professional certifications supported as part of learning and development. A range of retail discounts to enhance your lifestyle, encompassing restaurants, supermarkets, travel, leisure activities and health and well-being services. Access to our Employee Resource Groups, our groups represent diverse backgrounds and provide a platform for colleagues to connect, learn, and support one another. Company information Join Netcompany, where we proudly hold the 5th position on the esteemed UK Top 50 Best Places to Work in the Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Awards for 2024. At Netcompany, we pride ourselves on our entrepreneurial spirit and our capacity for doing things differently. Our culture is built on fostering low bureaucracy, emphasizing high agility and promoting flexibility, enabling everyone to contribute their best. Our journey began in the UK with the acquisition of Hunter Macdonald in 2017. As one of Northern Europe’s most accomplished IT companies, we have expanded our headcount globally to 7400+ employees and have offices in UK, Denmark, Norway, Poland, Holland and Vietnam. Netcompany is committed to providing an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment process for anyone wishing to apply for a job with us. We operate a Disability Confident Interview Scheme which means that we offer guaranteed interviews to all applicants with a disability who meet the minimum criteria for a role. Applicants are asked to opt in, so please let us know if you wish your application to be considered under this scheme. If you need any reasonable adjustments or extra support during the recruitment process, please contact us at [email protected]. #LI-RS1

items.description: About Vercel: Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what’s next. For more than a decade we’ve helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. Now we’re scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. About the Role: We are looking for a Product Manager to own the Vercel Dashboard, the control plane for every Vercel user, defining how developers and teams interact with Vercel from first login through daily use, across both individual accounts and enterprise organizations. You will lead the shift from what is a project listing page today to a personalized, agent-powered surface that proactively helps users ship and discover value. You will report to the Product Lead and will be located in San Francisco, CA (hybrid). If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday, even if the role is listed as remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team. What You Will Do: Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Vercel Dashboard, the primary surface through which all Vercel customers interact with the platform Define how agents operate within the Dashboard, from surfacing errors and suggesting fixes to updating code and config on behalf of users Shift the Dashboard from a passive “pull” experience to a proactive “push” experience, surfacing insights, notifications, and recommended actions Define the information architecture and design patterns that product area teams build within, and partner with those teams (Billing, CI/CD, Observability) to keep their experiences consistent and high-quality within the Dashboard shell Collaborate with Engineering to hold an uncompromising performance bar. The Dashboard must be the fastest, most delightful surface at Vercel Run experiments and measure onboarding funnel performance, feature adoption, and engagement across user segments About You: You’ve built and shipped developer-facing products You have experience with control planes, dashboards, or console products at infrastructure, cloud, or developer tools companies You have strong opinions on information architecture and how to organize complex products so they feel simple You think about the product from both a human and an agent perspective. You use AI tools in your own workflow and have a point of view on how agents should interact with product surfaces You have experience running experiments and working with product analytics to drive roadmap decisions Bonus If You: Have worked on platform or horizontal product teams where you set patterns that other teams adopt Have an engineering background or have built software yourself Have worked on onboarding, activation, or growth loops in a product-led growth context Have experience with personalization frameworks or systems that adapt to user segments and lifecycle stages Benefits: Competitive compensation package, including equity. Inclusive Healthcare Package. Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills. Flexible Time Off. We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed. The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $172,000 - $258,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process. Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don’t necessarily check every box on the job description. Disclosures: Privacy: Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Policy for more information on how we handle your data. Equal Opportunity: Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don’t necessarily check every box on the job description.

items.description: Hey, mabuhay! 👋 Thanks for dropping by. We know looking for the right job can feel like being stuck in EDSA traffic, so we’ll keep it moving and get straight to the point. With over 8 million downloads and a powerful network of thousand of dedicated biker-partners, we are a leading ride-hailing platform operating across the Philippines. Our vision is to end poverty in the Philippines through revolutionary transportation solutions. We aim to provide our customers with convenient, reliable, and safe rides, impacting millions of lives positively every single day. Now, we’re looking for a Workforce Specialist Service Excellence . As a Workforce Specialist at Angkas, acts as the operational backbone and tactical “brain” of the Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) industry. Its primary objective is to ensure the right number of agents, with the right skills, are in the right seats at the right time to handle customer interactions efficiently while minimizing operational costs. Responsible for; Demand Forecasting: Analyzes historical data, seasonal trends, marketing campaigns, and business cycles to predict future contact volumes (calls, chats, emails). Calculates required staffing hours using standard formulas (e.g., Forecasted Volume × Average Handle Time 360 secs) Staff Scheduling & Rostering: Builds optimal shift patterns, breaks, and off-days to match predicted peak and slow periods. Balances employee preferences, skill-set requirements, and labor rules while minimizing overstaffing or understaffing. Real-Time (Intraday) Management: Monitors live dashboards, queue lengths, average speed of answer (ASA), and abandon rates. Responds immediately to unexpected call spikes, system outages, or high absenteeism by reallocating staff, moving breaks, or calling in overtime. Adherence and Attendance Tracking: Tracks whether agents are logged in, handling contacts, or on scheduled breaks (aux/offline time) as planned. Measures schedule adherence to make sure agents stay productive during paid hours. SLA (Service Level Agreement) Protection: Ensures the Department meets or exceeds strict Management metrics (e.g., answering 85% of calls in 40 seconds, chats within 5 mins) to avoid potential cost Reporting and Analytics: Generates operational scorecards, shrinkage tracking, attrition data, and productivity reports for internal leadership and external clients. Evaluates long-term efficiency to refine future labor planning and payroll accuracy. At Angkas, we believe in giving our people the trust and flexibility to work in a way that helps them and their teams perform at their best. Whether you’re working onsite, remotely, or in a hybrid setup, we provide the flexibility, you bring the drive. ⚡ Let’s get this show on the road!🚦 Data Analytics on reading historical trends, tracking KPIs, and turning raw numbers into smart staffing decisions. Forecasting and Planning on predicting future workloads based on seasonality, business cycles, and past performance. Scheduling capability to building fair, cost-effective shifts that match employee availability with real-time operational needs. Compliance Knowledge to understanding labor laws, break rules, and overtime regulations to reduce legal risk. Software Proficiency to build templates and knowledge to use software WFM tools Communication in explaining complex staffing changes and schedule policies clearly to both workers and managers. Problem-Solving on fixing sudden staffing gaps or emergency absences quickly without hurting productivity. Supporting team members, building trust, and boosting workplace morale. Prioritizing daily operational tasks while keeping an eye on long-term goals. Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent reporting Minimum of 3 years of experience in WFM Ability to work under pressure, meet deadlines, and achieve team targets. Amenability to work onsite; working on weekends as Escalation POC (rotation based) Work your way – Enjoy flexibility and the freedom to thrive in your role. Work-life balance – Build a career without sacrificing your personal life. Free perks – Fuel up with free meals and stay active with gym access. Grow fast – Unlock career advancement and promotion opportunities. Get rewarded – Earn a competitive salary with opportunities for pay increases. Start-up energy – Be part of a fast-moving, innovative team where your ideas matter. Global vibes – Collaborate with a diverse, multicultural team in an agile workplace. Tech-driven culture – Work with modern tools and cutting-edge technology that keep you ahead of the game.

items.description: Software Engineering Surescripts serves the nation through simpler, trusted health intelligence sharing, in order to increase patient safety, lower costs and ensure quality care. We deliver insights at critical points of care for better decisions - from streamlining prior authorizations to delivering comprehensive medication histories to facilitating messages between providers. Job Summary: The Principal Infrastructure Engineer is crucial to ensuring the stability, efficiency and security of the products we operate as crucial components of the nation's healthcare ecosystem. As a member of our Operations team, a Principal Infrastructure Engineer is expected to have knowledge and experience spanning many disciplines with the ability to lead, communicate and execute as a subject matter expert on specific topics or systems. This role may be called upon to troubleshoot deeply technical problems, architect a solution for a new cloud-native application or write an Ansible module to support deployment of new security tooling. At the Principal level, our Platform Engineers are expected to be able to speak on a broad variety of topics and successfully lead projects both internal to our Systems or Operations teams as well as in collaboration with diverse groups of technical and non-technical team members. This position has a specific focus on systems performance tuning and analysis that is becoming even more crucial as we begin operations in Google Cloud Platform. Sizing, tuning troubleshooting and performance monitoring now draw a direct line to the budget as we transition to the minute-by-minute pricing models of the cloud. Knowing where we can gain efficiency and where we cannot sacrifice performance has become a crucial part of our architectural discussion and on-going operational health. Responsibilities: Participate in development of strategic goals and plans for new and existing systems infrastructure. Research, design, architect, and implement new technologies and solutions that span on-premise and cloud platforms in a method consistent with our security policies and infrastructure-as-code principals. Implement performance tuning strategies to optimize system performance, resource utilization, and overall efficiency. Collaborate with other teams to design and implement scalable and resilient infrastructure solutions. Assist in support of issues impacting the performance or reliability of production transactions. Recommend/implement policies, procedures, and technologies to ensure system security through secure system access, monitoring and control. Participate as necessary in routine security evaluations. Implement automation solutions for system provisioning, configuration management, and performance tuning. Ensure compliance with policies, standards, licensing agreements, configuration guidelines, and best-practices for maintaining regulatory compliance. Ensure all systems and processes are well-documented and comply with internal policies and industry standards. Qualifications: Basic Requirements: Bachelor's degree in IT, computer science, information sciences or related field or equivalent experience 8+ years of experience in systems engineering role Experience in a production operation environment with high uptime requirements. Familiarity with configuration management tools (Ansible preferred). Knowledge of virtualization and containerization technologies - Vmware (vSphere / ESXi 8x) and Kubernetes preferred Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Powershell, Python, Perl). Experience with performance, logging and monitoring tools (Zenoss, Splunk, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, etc.) Strong background in system metrics analysis and monitoring. Experience working in cloud environments (GCP preferred) Preferred Qualifications: Experience operating in an environment with sensitive health data Experience with RedHat, RockyOS and Windows Certifications like RHCE or Google Cloud Architect/Engineer Understanding of network operations, network troubleshooting and the ability to understand the output of packet captures Experience as a Team Lead, or non-people manager leadership role. Surescripts embraces flexibility through its Flexible Hybrid Work model for most positions. This model allows employees to work virtually while still utilizing our offices as collaboration centers. With alignment and agreement from your leadership, you can come and go from the office as needed. To be considered for employment, applicants must have a valid U.S. work authorization allowing work without restrictions with Surecripts in the U.S. At this time, we are unable to provide support or provide sponsorship for immigration benefits such as work visas. Additionally, we do not participate in academic training programs or work-study programs through an academic institution that require employer endorsement of F-1/CPT or F-1/STEM. What You're Like You're relentless in getting stuff done. You apply your expertise in an Agile/DevOps world with other talented people. You're curious about new technology and use your curiosity as fuel to deliver meaningful solutions. And you're into incremental efforts that ultimately reap huge results. What We're Like We're a smart team that loves to work toward a common goal: delivering innovative, industry-leading solutions that improve patient care. We pride ourselves on quality work grounded in transparency and accountability. Our goal is to make a positive impact on healthcare, be it on quality, cost, or patient safety. What the Work is Like Is your thinking cap on? (Do they still make those?) Here, our challenge is to connect disparate, cross-functional skills to create the desired result. We focus on important milestones, work to understand diverse technologies and develop relationships with various groups of people with varied perspectives. Why Wait? Apply Now We're a midsize company. This means you're not just another employee ID number. Here, you can build real relationships and feel supported by truly awesome people with diverse backgrounds and talents in an innovative and collaborative work culture. We strive to create an environment where you can be yourself, share your ideas and work your way. We offer opportunities for employee development, as well as competitive compensation packages and extensive benefits. At Surescripts, base pay is one part of our Total Rewards Package (which may also include bonus, benefits etc.) and is determined within a range. The base pay range for this position is $161,600 - $197,600 per year. Your base pay may vary within or outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including (but not limited to) your qualifications, skills, experience, and location. Benefits include, but are not limited to, comprehensive healthcare (including infertility coverage), generous paid time off including paid childbirth and parental leave and mental health days, pet insurance, and 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting. To learn more, review the Keep You and Yours Healthy , Balancing Work and Life , and Where Talent Takes Shape links under the Better Benefits. Better Work. Better Life section of our careers site. Physical and Mental Requirements While performing duties of this job, an employee may be required to perform any, or all of the following: attend meetings in and out of the office, travel, communicate effectively (both orally and in writing), and be able to effectively use computers and other electronic and standard office equipment with, or without, a reasonable accommodation. Additionally, this job requires certain mental demands, including the ability to use judgement, withstand moderate amounts of stress and maintain attention to detail with, or without, a reasonable accommodation. Surescripts is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, parental status, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law. #LI-REMOTE

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Sarasota, FL URL: https://www.simpletiger.com/ SimpleTiger is seeking a strategic, data-driven Senior PPC Manager to lead paid media strategy and execution for our B2B SaaS clients. This role is ideal for a seasoned performance marketer with 5+ years of hands-on experience building, managing, and optimizing multi-channel paid advertising campaigns. The Senior PPC Manager will own campaign performance across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram; translate client growth objectives into effective paid media strategies; and deliver clear, proactive communication and recommendations. You will work closely with our SEO, content, design, sales, and product teams to maximize qualified pipeline, customer acquisition, and return on ad spend for a portfolio of SaaS clients. Key Responsibilities Develop and lead comprehensive paid media strategies tailored to each client’s growth stage, business model, target audience, sales cycle, and revenue goals. Independently build, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram. Own campaign setup from end to end, including keyword research, audience strategy, account and campaign structure, ad group development, bid strategies, conversion tracking, budget allocation, and ad creative direction. Monitor and optimize campaigns against core performance metrics, including CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, conversion rate, pipeline contribution, ROAS, and ROI. Develop and manage testing roadmaps for ad copy, creative, landing pages, offers, audiences, bidding strategies, and campaign structures. Analyze performance data to identify trends, diagnose issues, uncover growth opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations. Partner with content and design teams to develop high-performing ad creative and messaging that resonates with B2B SaaS buyers. Collaborate with the SEO team to ensure PPC strategies complement broader organic search, content, and demand-generation initiatives. Manage paid media budgets responsibly, making informed recommendations on spend allocation, scaling opportunities, and efficiency improvements. Work directly with clients to communicate performance, explain strategy, set expectations, and provide timely, proactive updates and recommendations. Lead client-facing reporting and performance discussions, turning complex campaign data into clear business insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Partner with sales and product stakeholders to align campaign targeting, messaging, and conversion goals with customer insights and business priorities. Build and maintain strong relationships with platform representatives to access platform support, strategic guidance, beta opportunities, and new features. Stay current on paid media platform updates, privacy and tracking changes, B2B SaaS advertising trends, and emerging best practices. Contribute to the continued improvement of SimpleTiger’s PPC processes, reporting frameworks, account standards, and strategic playbooks. Provide mentorship, strategic guidance, and quality assurance support to junior team members as the PPC function grows. Requirements 5+ years of hands-on experience managing and optimizing PPC and paid social campaigns, ideally in B2B SaaS, an agency, or a high-growth technology environment. Proven experience managing substantial budgets across Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads, with required experience in Meta Ads Manager (Facebook and Instagram). Deep expertise in Google Ads, including Search, Display, YouTube, remarketing, Performance Max, conversion tracking, and automated bidding strategies. Strong working knowledge of LinkedIn and Meta advertising, including audience development, retargeting, lead-generation campaigns, and full-funnel B2B campaign strategy. Demonstrated success improving paid-media performance through structured testing, strategic budget allocation, ongoing optimization, and rigorous performance analysis. Experience launching campaigns from scratch and owning paid-media accounts from audit and strategy through execution, reporting, and continuous optimization. Proficiency with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, and comparable analytics, attribution, and reporting tools. Experience using AI-enabled tools and advertising-platform automation to improve campaign analysis, creative development, workflow efficiency, and optimization—while applying sound judgment to validate outputs and recommendations. Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms, preferably HubSpot, and with B2B SaaS funnel metrics including lead quality, MQLs, SQLs, pipeline, CAC, LTV, and revenue attribution. Strong analytical, written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex performance data into clear, actionable recommendations for clients and internal stakeholders. Highly organized, self-directed, and detail-oriented, with the judgment and accountability to manage multiple client accounts in a remote, results-driven environment. Google Ads and Meta Blueprint certifications preferred, but not required. Compensation & Benefits 100% remote work environment Results-oriented work environment Flexible working hours and vacation policy Company-provided computer for all team members All typical U.S. holidays observed with full paid time off Health insurance through the JustWorks HR platform 401(k) through Vestwell To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/simpletiger-b2b-saas-ppc-manager

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit. Why Worldwide We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us! What the Senior Statistician does at Worldwide Independently manages statistical project support and provides expert statistical consultancy across the stats function. What you will do Manage the statistics support to one or more projects/sponsor programs of work, ensuring that needs are met by expert and timely statistical consultancy and support Provides expert review of study designs, analysis plans, and reports Assist sponsors in the design of clinical trials, including statistical sections of the study protocol, randomization methodology, and writing statistical analysis plans Consult with internal departments, sponsors, and other third parties regarding statistical issues and reporting requirements Provide project support to the statistics reporting process through the specification/review of tables, figures, and listings shells, writing/review of derived dataset specifications, and the formatting of report documents and tabulations Undertake the preparation of final reports, including the production of tables, listings, and figures, and report writing Develop, evaluate, and run Statistical Analysis System (SAS) programs for the statistical analysis and reporting of clinical study data. This includes programs for derived datasets, Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium (CDISC), Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM), and Analysis Data Model (ADaM) datasets, tables, figures, and listings, and their validation Ensure the maintenance of documentation, e.g., the description of programs and validation Produce ad hoc data summaries when requested during a trial. Extract information from the system during a trial, e.g., summaries, data listings, study data sets. Validate software, in the role of system owner or tester, and test SAS Macros, maintaining the required validation and testing documentation Make statistical contributions to manuscripts for publication/presentation Provide support for the bidding process, including contribution to budget review, proposals, and bid defense meetings Lead the identification of system and process improvements, and develop and implement solutions to improve the efficiency and quality of clinical study data processing and reporting Support the development of statistical design and analysis policies Maintain knowledge in design consultancy and analysis methodology, statistical software packages (e.g., SAS and nQuery), and regulatory guidance documents, e.g. International Council for Harmonization (ICH), Food and Drug Administration (FDA), and Committee for Medicinal Products (CPMP) points to consider Assist with Quality Assurance and Audit requirements Assist the Director of Biostatistics with all other aspects of the job as required Perform all activities in compliance with Worldwide Clinical Trials and agreed sponsor quality system standards, relevant ICH standards, and specifically with FDA Quality System Regulation (including 21CFR Part 11) Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive. What you bring to the role: Computer literate and numerate with a proven ability to adapt to various computer systems Expert-level project statistician experienced in providing statistical leadership to projects Design and analysis consultancy skills and knowledge across a broad range of applications, together with key competencies in customer focus, delivering on commitments, building strong relationships, communicating, influencing, and embracing innovation and change Your experience Master's level in mathematics, statistics, or another subject required with a strong statistical component Minimum 3 years of statistical experience leading clinical trial projects and data analysis At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable workplace by providing transparent compensation. The salary range for this position is annually (For hourly paid positions, the stated salary range reflects hourly rates): United States of America - $87,500.00 - $173,500.00 The salary range provided is intended to give candidates an understanding of potential earnings. Compensation will fall within the provided range, and it not a guarantee of exact salary. The final salary will be determined based on relevant experience, performance, education, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive benefits package depending on location. We ensure pay equity and transparency and comply with all applicable labor laws. Salary information will be discussed during the interview process, and we encourage candidates to inquire about compensation at any stage. We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do. To view our other roles, check out our careers page at Discover a world of difference at Worldwide ! For more information on Worldwide, visit www.Worldwide.com or connect with us on LinkedIn .

items.title: IFRS reporting analyst
items.summary: MGID is a global native advertising platform that helps brands reach unique local audiences at scale.
items.description: MGID is a global native advertising platform that helps brands reach unique local audiences at scale. At MGID , we empower brands and publishers to collaborate transparently through our privacy-first targeting technology. This enables advertisers to drive performance and awareness while allowing publishers to retain and monetize their audiences. Today, we’re creating innovative technologies, and with your help, we aim to reach even greater heights. We are looking for an IFRS Reporting Analyst to join our Group Reporting team and help ensure accurate, consistent, and timely financial reporting across our international Group, with a focus on IFRS reporting, consolidation, intercompany reconciliations, and process improvement. What You’ll Do: Intercompany Reconciliation & Group Consolidation Perform monthly intercompany reconciliations across Group entities, ensuring balances and transactions are accurately matched and properly documented. Investigate intercompany discrepancies, identify root causes, and coordinate with local Finance teams to resolve differences within established reporting deadlines. Monitor outstanding intercompany balances and follow up with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely resolution. Support the preparation of intercompany eliminations and other consolidation adjustments required for Group reporting. Perform validation checks to ensure the completeness and accuracy of intercompany data used in the consolidation process. IFRS & Group Reporting Prepare and maintain standardized Group IFRS reporting packages, ensuring accurate and timely submission of financial information by Group entities. Review reporting packages for completeness, consistency, and compliance with Group reporting requirements and IFRS principles. Support the preparation of consolidated financial information and related reporting schedules. Perform analytical reviews of reported financial data, investigate unusual movements or inconsistencies, and follow up with local Finance teams where clarification is required. Support monthly, quarterly, and annual Group reporting activities in accordance with established reporting timelines. Chart of Accounts (CoA) Mapping Maintain and regularly review local-to-Group Chart of Accounts mappings across Group entities. Ensure consistent classification of financial information across different accounting systems and jurisdictions. Identify and resolve mapping inconsistencies and support improvements to the Group reporting structure. Local GAAP to IFRS Transformation Support the transformation of financial information from local GAAP to IFRS for Group reporting purposes. Identify differences between local accounting treatment and Group IFRS requirements and prepare or coordinate the required adjustments. items.title: Senior Machine Learning Developer
items.summary: Qohash is building the zero copy data security control layer, enterprises need to adopt AI safely.
items.description: Qohash is building the zero copy data security control layer, enterprises need to adopt AI safely. Our platform, Qostodian, helps large organizations discover, classify, govern, and remediate sensitive unstructured data across their most critical data sources without moving or copying the data. This zero copy architecture reduces exposure, preserves data sovereignty, and allows enterprises to secure data directly where it lives. This matters because AI adoption is increasing the risk, complexity, and urgency of enterprise data security. Before organizations can safely deploy AI agents, copilots, retrieval systems, or automated workflows, they need to know where sensitive data lives, who and what can access it, and how to enforce controls at scale. Company culture is at our core Our 5 core values are more than just words, they are a way of life for us. We know that companies with a strong culture and a higher purpose perform better in the long run. Do our values speak to you? Pursuit of excellence Resilience Mission focus Accountability Embracing conflict About the team We are standing up a new team for the QSIDS ( Qohash Sensitive Information Detection System) launch, dedicated to the detection engine. A central focus of this team is the integration of embedded AI, machine learning models that run directly on the device and in-system. It is about high-performance, low-resource, on-device inference, embedded into the detection engine itself. The engine is built in Go, with a strong emphasis on performance and minimal resource footprint. Who you are You're a hands-on Go developer who likes living close to the metal - profiling hot paths, trimming allocations, and making concurrent systems behave predictably under load. You enjoy integration work: wiring components, native libraries, and models into a coherent engine, and making the seams disappear. You take pride in owning what you ship, watching how it behaves in production and iterating to keep it fast and reliable. You bring strong engineering fundamentals, write tests as a matter of course, and collaborate naturally, helping the team converge on quality decisions. You're comfortable with the pace and ambiguity of a startup, and you care about the outcome, not just the code. What you will do Design and build a highly efficient cross-platform detection engine for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Integrate embedded machine learning models into the engine for on-device inference, and own the runtime, bindings, and data paths that make them work in-system. Collaborate closely with machine learning and systems colleagues to turn models into production-ready components. Optimize end to end for latency, memory footprint, and CPU — profiling, benchmarking, and tuning both engine code and model execution. Own features all the way to production including instrumenting, monitoring, and iterating to keep them reliable. Collaborate with stakeholders to define milestones and ensure timelines align with development needs. Participate in discussions on technological choices and decisions regarding product development. Resolve anomalies and problems as soon as they arise. Help onboard and train colleagues as the team grows. Communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. What your resume shows Must Haves 7+ years' experience building and shipping production software in Go Strong systems programming fundamentals - memory management, concurrency, profiling, and software optimization in performance-sensitive, resource-constrained environments Hands-on track record owning code post-deployment: instrumenting, debugging, and iterating on live systems A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience) Nice to Haves Experience embedding ML models for on-device inference (a strong asset for this role) Experience with Rust, C/C++ or another low-level systems language Experience building, training, or optimizing machine learning models, including compression, quantization, and tuning for low-latency inference Bilingual (French and English) Experience working in a startup environment What's in it for you? Competitive salary range. Enjoy up to six weeks of paid time off annually. At Qohash , we recognize your dedication and believe in giving you ample time to rejuvenate. Comprehensive health benefits package, including life insurance, short- and long-term disability insurance, paramedical and telemedicine services, and an HSA account. Qohash is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, colour, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. A working proficiency in English is required for this position based on the company’s operational requirements. Only those candidates selected for interview will be contacted. WHAT YOU'LL OWN IN YEAR ONE Own the practice's account management rhythm with structured weekly business reviews, account health scoring, and proactive risk identification across the existing client book Bring practice-level retention into the top quartile of the firm through tight service delivery, fast time-to-value on new accounts, and structured save-the-account interventions where necessary Develop and execute 5+ recurring expansion plays within the existing client base, building toward 1.5–2% monthly MRR expansion as a sustained rate Lead and develop the existing healthcare team, direct senior coaching, selective recruiting, and accountability for delivery quality Build a productized healthcare service offering that leverages the Interviewed platform: competitive intelligence, regulatory media monitoring, KOL targeting, payer narrative tracking Win new healthcare clients in partnership with our new business team, with focus on biotech, pharma, medical devices, hospital and health systems, digital health, and consumer wellness Represent the practice externally, industry events, healthcare-specific publications, thought leadership in the healthcare communications space QUALIFICATIONS Minimum of 15 years of experience in public relations, with a focus on the healthcare and lifestyle industries. Proven track record of successfully managing PR campaigns for healthcare clients, with measurable results in media placements and client satisfaction. Strong leadership and management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate a team to achieve excellence. Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to craft compelling narratives and communicate complex healthcare and lifestyle concepts effectively. Strategic thinker with a deep understanding of the healthcare industry. Extensive network of media contacts and industry connections within the healthcare and lifestyle sectors Results-oriented with a passion for delivering high-quality work and exceeding client expectations. WHO YOU ARE 15+ years in healthcare communications or healthcare PR, with senior leadership experience leading teams and owning practice-level outcomes Demonstrated specialty depth in at least three of: FDA and regulatory communications, biotech and pharma, medical devices, hospital and health systems, payer relations, clinical trial communications, digital health, healthcare policy A documented track record of measurable client retention and expansion you can describe in numbers Comfortable carrying gross revenue retention, net revenue retention, and expansion as primary KPIs, not just media impressions and placements Strong network of healthcare media contacts across business, trade, clinical, and consumer publications Strategic operator, equally fluent in client strategy, team development, and operational rigor Comfortable with AI-driven workflows and a data-disciplined approach to earned media WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT INTERDEPENDENCE 🏡 100% Remote, Forever - Work from anywhere in the world while you enjoy the flexibility of your fully remote workplace. Skip the annoying commute, create a workspace that works for you, and collaborate with teammates across the country, all without sacrificing connection or career growth. 🩺 Comprehensive Health Benefits - Choose from three Anthem Blue Cross PPO medical plans, plus dental and vision coverage to support your health and well-being. 💰 Retirement Savings - Save for the future with our 401(k) program, including a company match that is increasing further to 3% in 2027 . 🌴 Work-Life Balance - Enjoy paid vacation, sick time, 11 company holidays, a floating holiday, and Summer Fridays to recharge and spend more time doing what you love. 👶 Paid Parental Leave - We support growing families with paid parental leave, giving new parents dedicated time to recover, bond with their baby, and return to work with confidence. 📈 Career Growth - As one of the nation's fastest-growing strategic integrated marketing and communications firms, we're committed to helping ambitious people like you grow. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, lead from every level, and build a career with meaningful real impact. 🌟 Supportive, Collaborative Culture - We set high standards, celebrate big wins, and work together to achieve exceptional results. You'll join a team that's collaborative, entrepreneurial, and committed to helping one another succeed. HOW TO APPLY Submit your resume, a brief cover letter, and one additional document we genuinely want to read: a one-page write-up of your most significant healthcare client retention or expansion outcome. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Summary We are seeking an experienced Roblox Developer or small development team to build a polished Roblox experience from concept through launch. The experience will be promoted to a large kids-and-families audience, with a strong focus on engagement, scalability, and player retention. General information This project is being developed for two major social media creators with a combined audience of 20M+ followers. The Roblox experience is expected to be heavily promoted across their social platforms, so the build needs to support a high-quality player experience and scale effectively as adoption grows. The role covers end-to-end ownership across product planning, development, launch support, and post-launch iteration. This is initially a project-based engagement, with potential for ongoing development and support if the initial launch performs well. Tasks and Deliverables We are looking for a developer/team that can own the project A–Z, including: Game concept and gameplay planning Roblox Studio development Map/world design 3D assets and environments Luau scripting Core gameplay mechanics Multiplayer systems UI/UX Player progression and rewards Data saving Monetization systems Mobile, tablet, PC, and console optimization Testing, debugging, and QA Roblox publishing and launch support Analytics and performance tracking Post-launch updates and improvements Required experience Strong portfolio of published Roblox experiences Deep experience with Roblox Studio and Luau Experience building games designed for large player counts Strong understanding of retention, progression, monetization, and Roblox game loops Experience optimizing Roblox experiences across devices Able to take ownership of both the technical development and overall product Strong communication and project-management skills Experience launching and maintaining successful Roblox games is highly preferred To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-pt-ft-senior-roblox-developer-game-designer

items.title: AI Creative Director / AI Associate Creative Director
items.summary: Superside is seeking visionary AI Creative Directors/Associate Creative Directors to guide a globally distributed team across branding, ad and social creative, presentations, print, and landing pages. In this high-impact role, you’ll shape the future of AI-enhanced creativity by integrating generative tools into our design workflows, elevating both quality and efficiency. You’ll lead by example as both a maker and a mentor, balancing hands-on creative work with strategic guidance. Collaborating with some of the world’s most ambitious brands, you’ll inspire cross-functional teams, develop human-centered creative strategies, and help build a scalable design practice rooted in experimentation, feedback, and continuous improvement.

You’ll act as both a mentor and a maker, fostering collaboration, empathy, and clarity across every project. You bring curiosity, composure, and humility to your leadership, helping others grow while delivering consistently outstanding creative work.

items.title: Creative (Graphic Designer)
items.summary: Superside is looking for a talented Graphic Designer to join our global creative team. You'll create standout visual work for some of the world's most ambitious brands: from brand identity and campaign design to digital and social assets. You’ll be working alongside creative leads, project managers, and clients across a wide range of industries. This is a hands-on design role built for the way design actually gets made today. You'll spend most of your time designing, building concepts, refining visual systems, and pushing craft, using today's leading AI creative tools as a core part of your process, not an afterthought. We're looking for designers who already treat tools & models like Flora, Krea, Figma AI, Claude, NanoBanana, GPT Image, and Seedance as part of their everyday kit, and who know when to reach for them and when strong traditional craft is what the work actually needs.
